FNS_Collect.help: Dry-run of Collect All & Save: scans every file parameter for references outside the project folder and reports the count and total size in Collect Status (details returned to callers). Nothing is copied or rewritten.

FNS_Collect.name: Collectsave
FNS_Collect.label: Collect All & Save
FNS_Collect.help: Copies every external audio/movie/geometry/image file reference into {project}/collected/<category>/, rewrites those parameters to project-relative paths, then saves the .toe. Originals are never moved or deleted; expression-driven parameters are left untouched. Progress appears in Collect Status.

FNS_Collect.name: Collectexpr
FNS_Collect.label: Freeze Expression Refs
FNS_Collect.help: Freeze expressions on collected file references. Off by default: an expression that happens to evaluate to a path is live wiring, and resolving it would detach that rather than bake a value.

FNS_Collect.name: Collectstatus
FNS_Collect.label: Collect Status
FNS_Collect.help: Live progress / result of the most recent scan or collect run.

FNS_ColorUI.name: Openui
FNS_ColorUI.label: Open UI
FNS_ColorUI.help: Open the colour editor. It is also the OpColor tab of FNS_Hub, and, with Expose on the Registry page, a tab of FNS_Console in the browser.

FNS_ColorUI.name: File
FNS_ColorUI.label: File (.json)
FNS_ColorUI.help: Where Export writes and Import reads. A .json file you can keep in a project, commit, or hand to someone else.

FNS_ColorUI.name: Import
FNS_ColorUI.label: Import
FNS_ColorUI.help: Read colours from the file above and apply them. Imported colours take precedence over the ones saved locally in the component.

FNS_ColorUI.name: Export
FNS_ColorUI.label: Export
FNS_ColorUI.help: Write the current colours to the file above, so they can be shared or version-controlled.

FNS_ColorUI.name: Autoload
FNS_ColorUI.label: Auto-Load Colors
FNS_ColorUI.help: Apply the colours saved in this component when the project opens. Off leaves TouchDesigner's own colours until you open the UI and apply.

FNS_ColorUI.name: Groupby
FNS_ColorUI.label: Group By
FNS_ColorUI.help: How the editor's list is organised: Prefix groups elements by the name they start with, Role groups them by what they are used for.

FNS_CommandPalette.name: Hotkey
FNS_CommandPalette.label: Hotkey
FNS_CommandPalette.help: Keyboard shortcut that opens the palette. Space-separated combos, parts joined with a dot, e.g. ctrl.shift.p. Rebind it from FNS_HotkeyManager.

FNS_CommandPalette.name: Justifyoffsetto
FNS_CommandPalette.label: Justify and Offset To...
FNS_CommandPalette.help: Which display the palette window is placed on: the primary one, the one set on the window, or the bounds of all displays.

FNS_CommandPalette.name: Ignoretaskbar
FNS_CommandPalette.label: Ignore Taskbar
FNS_CommandPalette.help: Place the palette as if the taskbar were not there.

FNS_CommandPalette.name: Dpiscaling
FNS_CommandPalette.label: DPI Scaling
FNS_CommandPalette.help: Size the palette in native pixels, or scaled with the display DPI.

FNS_CommandPalette.name: Single
FNS_CommandPalette.label: Shift to Single Display
FNS_CommandPalette.help: Keep the palette on one display: off, on a single display, or on the display with the cursor.

FNS_CommandPalette.name: Favouritekeys
FNS_CommandPalette.label: Favourite keys
FNS_CommandPalette.help: Legacy store of starred command identities (tool#id) from before the shared curation file; adopted into that file on first read, then emptied.

FNS_CommandPalette.name: Queryhistory
FNS_CommandPalette.label: Query history
FNS_CommandPalette.help: JSON list of executed palette queries, oldest first, recalled with Alt+Up / Alt+Down. Persisted by the config host.

FNS_CommandPalette.name: Visibilityoverrides
FNS_CommandPalette.label: Visibility overrides
FNS_CommandPalette.help: Legacy store of visibility overrides (tool#id -> hidden or shown) from before the shared curation file; adopted into that file on first read, then emptied.

FNS_CommandPalette.name: Presets
FNS_CommandPalette.label: Presets
FNS_CommandPalette.help: Legacy store of presets from before the shared curation file; adopted into that file on first read, then emptied.

FNS_CommandPalette.name: Rankbyusage
FNS_CommandPalette.label: Rank By Usage
FNS_CommandPalette.help: Commands you run often rank higher: a small bonus that fades with a 14-day half-life and breaks ties between similar matches, never above a better match or a favourite. Usage is shared with the TDXLU launcher (command-usage.json) and recorded even when this is off.

FNS_CommandRegistry.name: Rescan
FNS_CommandRegistry.label: Rescan Tools
FNS_CommandRegistry.help: Re-collect commands from COMPs tagged 'fnscommands' that promote FnsCommands(). Runs automatically on init; pulse after dropping a tool in by hand.

FNS_CommandRegistry.name: Status
FNS_CommandRegistry.label: Status
FNS_CommandRegistry.help: Read-only summary of the current registry: command and tool counts plus the change revision.

FNS_ConfigHost.name: Comp
FNS_ConfigHost.label: Tool COMP
FNS_ConfigHost.help: Tool COMP whose settings are persisted. Defaults to the parent component (the host lives inside the tool it publishes).

FNS_ConfigHost.name: Canonicalname
FNS_ConfigHost.label: Canonical Name
FNS_ConfigHost.help: Unique name for this tool's section in the config file.

FNS_ConfigHost.name: Callback
FNS_ConfigHost.label: Callback DAT
FNS_ConfigHost.help: Optional config_callbacks DAT for state beyond parameters (onConfigSave/onConfigLoad).

FNS_ConfigHost.name: Createcallbacks
FNS_ConfigHost.label: Create Callbacks
FNS_ConfigHost.help: Spawn a 'config_callbacks' DAT into this tool from the registry's template and wire this host's Callback parameter to it. Safe to pulse again: an existing DAT is adopted, never overwritten.

FNS_ConfigHost.name: Autoregister
FNS_ConfigHost.label: Auto-register
FNS_ConfigHost.help: When on, keep this tool published into the global config registry while this component exists.

FNS_ConfigHost.name: Register
FNS_ConfigHost.label: Register
FNS_ConfigHost.help: Publish once into the global config registry, even if Auto-register is off.

FNS_ConfigHost.name: Unregister
FNS_ConfigHost.label: Unregister
FNS_ConfigHost.help: Take this tool's contribution back out of the registry and turn Autoregister off, so it stays out. Register puts it back.

FNS_ConfigHost.name: Regstatus
FNS_ConfigHost.label: Registration Status
FNS_ConfigHost.help: Read-only status of this host registration.

FNS_ConfigHost.name: Autoload
FNS_ConfigHost.label: Auto-load
FNS_ConfigHost.help: Apply this tool's saved section from the config file once per session, shortly after the tool registers. Turn off for a tool whose settings should stay project-local.

FNS_ConfigHost.name: Persistpars
FNS_ConfigHost.label: Persist Parameters
FNS_ConfigHost.help: Snapshot and restore the tool COMP's custom parameters (value, expression, bind + mode). Meta pages (About, Version Ctrl, Info, Callbacks, Common) are always skipped; missing parameters are never created on load.

FNS_ConfigHost.name: Excludepars
FNS_ConfigHost.label: Exclude Pars
FNS_ConfigHost.help: Space-separated name patterns (tdu.match) of custom parameters to leave out of persistence, e.g. 'Spoutactive Ndi*'. Use for parameters that must boot at their defaults.

FNS_ConfigHost.name: Excludepages
FNS_ConfigHost.label: Exclude Pages
FNS_ConfigHost.help: Space-separated page-name patterns to leave out of persistence entirely.

FNS_ConfigHost.name: Helpurl
FNS_ConfigHost.label: Help URL
FNS_ConfigHost.help: The tool's wiki/help page. Informational for config; leave empty to skip.

FNS_ConfigHost.name: Promotepars
FNS_ConfigHost.label: Promote Parameters
FNS_ConfigHost.help: When on, the host mirrors its key Registration parameters onto the parent tool as a bound 'Registry' page. Turn off before shipping a tool that should not expose registry controls.

FNS_ConfigHost.name: Configscope
FNS_ConfigHost.label: Config Scope
FNS_ConfigHost.help: Follows the toolkit root's Config Scope (op.FNS, FNSTools page) through a guarded expression, and reads 'project' when there is no root: a standalone tool release keeps its settings in the .toe. Author on the root; the root par is the record.

FNS_ConfigHost.name: Configfile
FNS_ConfigHost.label: Config File
FNS_ConfigHost.help: Override the config file location. Empty = the user palette default (FNSTools/config/FNStools_config.json). Evaluated by the /sys global; set it on the FNS_Config master so promotion carries it.

FNS_ConfigHost.name: Saveall
FNS_ConfigHost.label: Save All Now
FNS_ConfigHost.help: Snapshot every registered tool into the config file now (forwards to the global).

FNS_ConfigHost.name: Loadall
FNS_ConfigHost.label: Load All Now
FNS_ConfigHost.help: Re-apply every registered tool's saved section now (forwards to the global).

FNS_ConfigRegistry.name: Comp
FNS_ConfigRegistry.label: Tool COMP
FNS_ConfigRegistry.help: Tool COMP whose settings are persisted. Defaults to the parent component (the host lives inside the tool it publishes).

FNS_ConfigRegistry.name: Canonicalname
FNS_ConfigRegistry.label: Canonical Name
FNS_ConfigRegistry.help: Unique name for this tool's section in the config file.

FNS_ConfigRegistry.name: Callback
FNS_ConfigRegistry.label: Callback DAT
FNS_ConfigRegistry.help: Optional config_callbacks DAT for state beyond parameters (onConfigSave/onConfigLoad).

FNS_ConfigRegistry.name: Createcallbacks
FNS_ConfigRegistry.label: Create Callbacks
FNS_ConfigRegistry.help: Spawn a 'config_callbacks' DAT into this tool from the registry's template and wire this host's Callback parameter to it. Safe to pulse again: an existing DAT is adopted, never overwritten.

FNS_ConfigRegistry.name: Autoregister
FNS_ConfigRegistry.label: Auto-register
FNS_ConfigRegistry.help: When on, keep this tool published into the global config registry while this component exists.

FNS_ConfigRegistry.name: Register
FNS_ConfigRegistry.label: Register
FNS_ConfigRegistry.help: Publish once into the global config registry, even if Auto-register is off.

FNS_ConfigRegistry.name: Unregister
FNS_ConfigRegistry.label: Unregister
FNS_ConfigRegistry.help: Take this tool's contribution back out of the registry and turn Autoregister off, so it stays out. Register puts it back.

FNS_ConfigRegistry.name: Regstatus
FNS_ConfigRegistry.label: Registration Status
FNS_ConfigRegistry.help: Read-only status of this host registration.

FNS_ConfigRegistry.name: Autoload
FNS_ConfigRegistry.label: Auto-load
FNS_ConfigRegistry.help: Apply this tool's saved section from the config file once per session, shortly after the tool registers. Turn off for a tool whose settings should stay project-local.

FNS_ConfigRegistry.name: Persistpars
FNS_ConfigRegistry.label: Persist Parameters
FNS_ConfigRegistry.help: Snapshot and restore the tool COMP's custom parameters (value, expression, bind + mode). Meta pages (About, Version Ctrl, Info, Callbacks, Common) are always skipped; missing parameters are never created on load.

FNS_ConfigRegistry.name: Excludepars
FNS_ConfigRegistry.label: Exclude Pars
FNS_ConfigRegistry.help: Space-separated name patterns (tdu.match) of custom parameters to leave out of persistence, e.g. 'Spoutactive Ndi*'. Use for parameters that must boot at their defaults.

FNS_ConfigRegistry.name: Excludepages
FNS_ConfigRegistry.label: Exclude Pages
FNS_ConfigRegistry.help: Space-separated page-name patterns to leave out of persistence entirely.

FNS_ConfigRegistry.name: Helpurl
FNS_ConfigRegistry.label: Help URL
FNS_ConfigRegistry.help: The tool's wiki/help page. Informational for config; leave empty to skip.

FNS_ConfigRegistry.name: Promotepars
FNS_ConfigRegistry.label: Promote Parameters
FNS_ConfigRegistry.help: When on, the host mirrors its key Registration parameters onto the parent tool as a bound 'Registry' page. Turn off before shipping a tool that should not expose registry controls.

FNS_ConfigRegistry.name: Presaveheal
FNS_ConfigRegistry.label: Pre-Save Heal
FNS_ConfigRegistry.help: Before each project save, re-check this registry: update entries whose component moved, drop entries whose component is gone, and republish a host that initialised before the global registry existed. Off skips the sweep for this registry only.

FNS_ConfigRegistry.name: Configscope
FNS_ConfigRegistry.label: Config Scope
FNS_ConfigRegistry.help: Follows the toolkit root's Config Scope (op.FNS, FNSTools page) through a guarded expression, and reads 'project' when there is no root: a standalone tool release keeps its settings in the .toe. Author on the root; the root par is the record. Where FNSTools' persisted settings and bar layouts live: global roams through one file in the user palette, project never reads or writes it.

FNS_ConfigRegistry.name: Configfile
FNS_ConfigRegistry.label: Config File
FNS_ConfigRegistry.help: Override the config file location. Empty = the user palette default (FNSTools/config/FNStools_config.json). Evaluated by the /sys global; set it on the FNS_Config master so promotion carries it.

FNS_ConfigRegistry.name: Saveall
FNS_ConfigRegistry.label: Save All Now
FNS_ConfigRegistry.help: Snapshot every registered tool into the config file now (forwards to the global).

FNS_ConfigRegistry.name: Loadall
FNS_ConfigRegistry.label: Load All Now
FNS_ConfigRegistry.help: Re-apply every registered tool's saved section now (forwards to the global).

FNS_Console.name: Comp
FNS_Console.label: Tool COMP
FNS_Console.help: The tool that contributes this tab. Defaults to the parent component (the host lives inside the tool it publishes).

FNS_Console.name: Canonicalname
FNS_Console.label: Canonical Name
FNS_Console.help: Unique, URL-safe name of the tab (letters, digits, _ -). It is the path: /t/<name>/. Leave empty to use the tool COMP name.

FNS_Console.name: Tabpage
FNS_Console.label: Tab Page
FNS_Console.help: Text DAT holding the tab's HTML. Served verbatim in the console under /t/<name>/. Inline its CSS and JS; relative fetches resolve under that path.

FNS_Console.name: Tabapi
FNS_Console.label: Tab API
FNS_Console.help: Optional Python DAT defining onConsoleRequest(action, method, body) -> JSON-able. Answers /t/<name>/api/<action>; body is the parsed JSON of a POST, else None.

FNS_Console.name: Localbrowser
FNS_Console.label: Local Browser
FNS_Console.help: Optional: the tool's own web browser panel (a palette webBrowser COMP) rendering the same page. While this tab is exposed the console serves the page, so the console switches that browser's Active off, a renderer nobody looks at, and back on when the exposure ends.

FNS_Console.name: Autoregister
FNS_Console.label: Expose to Console
FNS_Console.help: Publish this tab into the console while the component exists. Off = the tool runs only its own local interface and contributes nothing.

FNS_Console.name: Register
FNS_Console.label: Register
FNS_Console.help: Publish once into the console, even if Expose is off.

FNS_Console.name: Unregister
FNS_Console.label: Unregister
FNS_Console.help: Take this tool's contribution back out of the registry and turn Autoregister off, so it stays out. Register puts it back.

FNS_Console.name: Regstatus
FNS_Console.label: Registration Status
FNS_Console.help: Read-only status of this host registration.

FNS_Console.name: Displayed
FNS_Console.label: Shown in Console
FNS_Console.help: Show this tab on the console's tab bar. Off keeps the tab registered but hidden. It stays listed in the console's tab manager, which writes its choice back here.

FNS_Console.name: Tablabel
FNS_Console.label: Tab Label
FNS_Console.help: What the console's tab bar shows. Empty = the canonical name.

FNS_Console.name: Taborder
FNS_Console.label: Tab Order
FNS_Console.help: Position in the tab bar. Built-ins sit at 0 (Settings) and 10 (Install & remove); contributions default to 50 and sort by this, then by label.

FNS_Console.name: Helpurl
FNS_Console.label: Help URL
FNS_Console.help: The tool's wiki/help page. Informational; leave empty to skip.

FNS_Console.name: Promotepars
FNS_Console.label: Promote Parameters
FNS_Console.help: When on, the host mirrors its key Registration parameters onto the parent tool as a bound Registry page. Turn off before shipping a tool that should not expose registry controls.

FNS_Console.name: Presaveheal
FNS_Console.label: Pre-Save Heal
FNS_Console.help: Before each project save, re-check this registry: update entries whose component moved, drop entries whose component is gone, and republish a host that initialised before the global registry existed. Off skips the sweep for this registry only.

FNS_Console.name: Open
FNS_Console.label: Open Console
FNS_Console.help: Serve the console (on the first free port of 36710-36759) and show it, in the toolkit root's webBrowser panel when there is one, else your system browser.

FNS_CustomParTools.name: Refbind
FNS_CustomParTools.label: Ref/Bind
FNS_CustomParTools.help: How a promoted parameter is linked back to the original. On binds the two (either end can be edited and both follow); off leaves the original in expression mode pointing at the promoted one. Holding the modifier while promoting inverts this for that one action.

FNS_CustomParTools.name: Promote
FNS_CustomParTools.label: Promote All
FNS_CustomParTools.help: Promote every custom parameter on the current page of the referenced COMP to the target COMP at once, linked according to Ref/Bind.

FNS_CustomParTools.name: Shortcutcurrentpars
FNS_CustomParTools.label: Params: Selected
FNS_CustomParTools.help: Hotkey that opens the parameter dialog for the SELECTED operator. Rebindable here or in FNS_HotkeyManager.

FNS_CustomParTools.name: Shortcutparentpars
FNS_CustomParTools.label: Params: Current COMP
FNS_CustomParTools.help: Hotkey that opens the parameter dialog for the COMP whose network is showing.

FNS_CustomParTools.name: Shortcutcurrentcomp
FNS_CustomParTools.label: Editor: Selected
FNS_CustomParTools.help: Hotkey that opens the component editor for the SELECTED operator.

FNS_CustomParTools.name: Shortcutparentcomp
FNS_CustomParTools.label: Editor: Current COMP
FNS_CustomParTools.help: Hotkey that opens the component editor for the COMP whose network is showing.

FNS_CustomParTools.name: Activeparpromote
FNS_CustomParTools.label: Parameter Promotion
FNS_CustomParTools.help: Drop a parameter onto the CustomParTools button to promote it onto the current network COMP. The core action of the tool.

FNS_CustomParTools.name: Activequickext
FNS_CustomParTools.label: QuickExt
FNS_CustomParTools.help: Create an extension on the current COMP from the button.

FNS_CustomParTools.name: Activequickparent
FNS_CustomParTools.label: QuickParent
FNS_CustomParTools.help: Set a parent shortcut on the current COMP from the button.

FNS_CustomParTools.name: Activeclearpars
FNS_CustomParTools.label: ClearPars
FNS_CustomParTools.help: Alt-click (Cmd on macOS) the button to clear the custom parameters of the current child.

FNS_CustomParTools.name: Activeioppromoter
FNS_CustomParTools.label: IOP Promoter
FNS_CustomParTools.help: Hold the modifier while dropping an operator on the button to promote it as an Internal OP instead of promoting parameters.

FNS_CustomParTools.name: Activehijackdragdrop
FNS_CustomParTools.label: Navbar Drag/Drop
FNS_CustomParTools.help: Accept operator and parameter drops anywhere on the pane navigation bar. Off UNREGISTERS the widget, removing it from every bar.

FNS_CustomParTools.name: Activepathcellclickinject
FNS_CustomParTools.label: Navbar Path Cell Click
FNS_CustomParTools.help: Open parameters for the operator whose path cell you click in the pane bar. Off UNREGISTERS the widget, removing it from every bar.

FNS_CustomParTools.name: Activequickparcustom
FNS_CustomParTools.label: QuickParCustom
FNS_CustomParTools.help: Rollover hotkeys for promoting and customizing the parameter under the mouse. Bound to QuickParCustom's own Active switch.

FNS_CustomParTools.name: Activetdshortcuts
FNS_CustomParTools.label: Parameter/Editor Hotkeys
FNS_CustomParTools.help: The four stock-TouchDesigner hotkeys on the Custom page (open parameters, open component editor). Off deactivates the keyboardins; the matching quick-launch commands stay available.

FNS_ExprHotStrings.name: Replaceinline
FNS_ExprHotStrings.label: Replace inline
FNS_ExprHotStrings.help: Expand an abbreviation anywhere inside an expression, not only when it is the whole expression. Off by default: with it on you can write '#AT * 0.2' and combine abbreviations.

FNS_ExprHotStrings.name: Customparpromoteenable
FNS_ExprHotStrings.label: CustomPar Promote Enable (#@! for binds, #!~ for refs)
FNS_ExprHotStrings.help: Enable the promote abbreviations: '#@!' binds a parameter to the parent and '#!~' references it. On by default.

FNS_ExprHotStrings.name: Sync
FNS_ExprHotStrings.label: Externalize
FNS_ExprHotStrings.help: Externalize the abbreviation table to a file on disk, so it can be edited outside TouchDesigner and version-controlled.

FNS_ExprHotStrings.name: Openable
FNS_ExprHotStrings.label: #@op Wrap Enable
FNS_ExprHotStrings.help: Enable the '#@' abbreviation, which wraps whatever follows in op('...'). '#@noise1.par.amp' becomes op('noise1').par.amp.

FNS_ExprHotStrings.name: Parentshortcutenable
FNS_ExprHotStrings.label: #! Parent Shortcut Enable
FNS_ExprHotStrings.help: Enable the '#!' abbreviations, which resolve to the closest parent shortcut ('#!' alone, or '#!!' with .par appended).

FNS_ExprHotStrings.name: Open
FNS_ExprHotStrings.label: Edit Table
FNS_ExprHotStrings.help: Open the abbreviation table, where the first column is what you type and the second is what it expands to.

FNS_ExprHotStrings.name: Author
FNS_ExprHotStrings.label: Author: Function Store @function.str

FNS_ExprHotStrings.name: Usage
FNS_ExprHotStrings.label: Usage:

FNS_ExprHotStrings.name: L1
FNS_ExprHotStrings.label: - add new lines to the table

FNS_ExprHotStrings.name: L2
FNS_ExprHotStrings.label: - start abbreviation (first column) with a unique character

FNS_ExprHotStrings.name: L3
FNS_ExprHotStrings.label: - it will expand to what you write in the second column

FNS_ExprHotStrings.name: L4
FNS_ExprHotStrings.label: - type the abbreviation into a parameter's expression box

FNS_ExprHotStrings.name: L5
FNS_ExprHotStrings.label: - and keep your mouse over it to expand!

FNS_ExprHotStrings.name: L6
FNS_ExprHotStrings.label: - The contents of the table are saved across your projects if sync is enabled!

FNS_ExprHotStrings.name: L7
FNS_ExprHotStrings.label: - If enabled #@ will wrap strings after it in op('...') in a smart way

FNS_ExprHotStrings.name: L9
FNS_ExprHotStrings.label: - If enabled #! will resolve to the closest parent shortcut

FNS_ExprHotStrings.name: L10
FNS_ExprHotStrings.label: -- and #!! will also add a .par after it

FNS_ExprHotStrings.name: L11
FNS_ExprHotStrings.label: - If enabled #@! or #!~ will promote parameter as custom par

FNS_ExprHotStrings.name: L12
FNS_ExprHotStrings.label: -- Can also directly write a custom name such as #@!Myfloat

FNS_ExprHotStrings.name: L8
FNS_ExprHotStrings.label: - The definitions can be synced across projects if Externalized is enabled

FNS_GlobalOutSelect.name: Refresh
FNS_GlobalOutSelect.label: Refresh
FNS_GlobalOutSelect.help: Rescan the project for global OP shortcuts and their out operators. The list is refreshed only on demand, so that walking the project never costs a frame while you work.

FNS_GlobalVolControl.name: Volume
FNS_GlobalVolControl.label: Volume
FNS_GlobalVolControl.help: TouchDesigner's overall output volume, 0 to 1. This is the application-wide level, not a per-operator one.

FNS_GlobalVolControl.name: Mute
FNS_GlobalVolControl.label: Mute
FNS_GlobalVolControl.help: Silence TouchDesigner's audio output without losing the Volume setting.

FNS_HotkeyManager.name: Active
FNS_HotkeyManager.label: Active
FNS_HotkeyManager.help: Turn hotkey management on or off. Off leaves every binding as it is but stops the manager applying, saving or restoring them.

FNS_HotkeyManager.name: Savehotkeys
FNS_HotkeyManager.label: Save Hotkeys
FNS_HotkeyManager.help: Write the declared bindings to your user palette now, so they survive project files and updates. Toolkit hotkeys are always declared; anything else has to be tagged FNS_hotkeys or ticked in the lister's Persist column.

FNS_HotkeyManager.name: Loadhotkeys
FNS_HotkeyManager.label: Load Hotkeys
FNS_HotkeyManager.help: Re-apply the saved bindings from your user palette over what is bound right now.

FNS_HotkeyManager.name: Loaddefault
FNS_HotkeyManager.label: Load Default
FNS_HotkeyManager.help: Put every discovered binding back to the default its own parameter declares, discarding your saved bindings for this session.

FNS_HotkeyManager.name: Forcedefault
FNS_HotkeyManager.label: Force Default
FNS_HotkeyManager.help: Ignore saved bindings entirely and use each parameter's declared default on every load. Use it to get a machine back to a known state; leave it off to keep your own bindings.

FNS_HotkeyManager.name: Excluderoots
FNS_HotkeyManager.label: Excluded Roots
FNS_HotkeyManager.help: Space-separated names of top-level components to SKIP during project-wide hotkey discovery. TD's own ui/sys/local are excluded by default; add other roots here to silence them.

FNS_HotkeyManager.name: Openui
FNS_HotkeyManager.label: Open Hotkey UI
FNS_HotkeyManager.help: Open the hotkey configurator panel: every discovered binding grouped by tool, click a Hotkey cell to rebind via key capture, right-click to reset to default. Conflicts are flagged in the Status column.

FNS_Hub.name: Open
FNS_Hub.label: Open Hub
FNS_Hub.help: Open the FNS Hub window, the toolkit's one-stop manager: every registry's configurator, the console, and any tab a tool contributes.

FNS_Hub.name: Tabbar
FNS_Hub.label: Tab Bar
FNS_Hub.help: How the hub's tab bar lays out. Rows: fixed-width tabs that wrap into as many rows as needed. Strip: TouchDesigner's folder-tabs widget: one row with scroll arrows and a dropdown, and drag-to-reorder. Neither has close buttons: hide a tab from its tool's Registry page, bring it back from the right-click menu.

FNS_Hub.name: Activetab
FNS_Hub.label: Active Tab
FNS_Hub.help: Canonical name of the tab currently shown. Written by the tab bar; roams with the config registry so the hub reopens where you left it.

FNS_Hub.name: Tabuserorder
FNS_Hub.label: Tab User Order
FNS_Hub.help: Space-separated canonical names in the order you dragged the tabs into. Tabs not listed follow in their registered order. Roams with the config registry.

FNS_Hub.name: Refreshtabs
FNS_Hub.label: Refresh Tabs
FNS_Hub.help: Re-read the hub registry and rebuild the tab bar. Normally automatic; use after a manual edit inside the tabs container.

FNS_HubRegistry.name: Comp
FNS_HubRegistry.label: Tool COMP
FNS_HubRegistry.help: The tool that contributes this tab. Defaults to the parent component (the host lives inside the tool it publishes).

FNS_HubRegistry.name: Canonicalname
FNS_HubRegistry.label: Canonical Name
FNS_HubRegistry.help: Unique name of the tab (letters, digits, _ -). It names the hub's mirror (hubtab_<name>). Leave empty to use the tool COMP name.

FNS_HubRegistry.name: Tabcontent
FNS_HubRegistry.label: Tab Content
FNS_HubRegistry.help: What the tab shows. Empty = the tool COMP itself (it must be a panel). A panel COMP anywhere inside the tool is mirrored into the hub; a DAT/CHOP/TOP/SOP/POP is shown through an OP Viewer. Ignored when Tab Parameters is set.

FNS_HubRegistry.name: Tabparams
FNS_HubRegistry.label: Tab Parameters
FNS_HubRegistry.help: Show a parameter view of the tool COMP instead of a panel: the page scope to display (e.g. 'Settings', or * for every page). Empty = not a parameter tab.

FNS_HubRegistry.name: Autoregister
FNS_HubRegistry.label: Show in Hub
FNS_HubRegistry.help: Publish this tab into FNS_Hub while the component exists. Off = the tool shows nothing in the hub and its panel stays wherever it lives.

FNS_HubRegistry.name: Register
FNS_HubRegistry.label: Register
FNS_HubRegistry.help: Publish once into the hub, even if Show in Hub is off.

FNS_HubRegistry.name: Unregister
FNS_HubRegistry.label: Unregister
FNS_HubRegistry.help: Take this tool's contribution back out of the registry and turn Autoregister off, so it stays out. Register puts it back.

FNS_HubRegistry.name: Regstatus
FNS_HubRegistry.label: Registration Status
FNS_HubRegistry.help: Read-only status of this host registration.

FNS_HubRegistry.name: Displayed
FNS_HubRegistry.label: Shown in Hub
FNS_HubRegistry.help: Show this tab on the hub's tab bar. Off keeps the tab registered but hidden. The hub's tab manager can show it again.

FNS_HubRegistry.name: Tablabel
FNS_HubRegistry.label: Tab Label
FNS_HubRegistry.help: What the hub's tab bar shows. Empty = the canonical name.

FNS_HubRegistry.name: Taborder
FNS_HubRegistry.label: Tab Order
FNS_HubRegistry.help: Position in the hub's tab bar; the surface configurators sit at 10/20/30, the console viewer at 90; contributions default to 50 and sort by label within an order.

FNS_HubRegistry.name: Helpurl
FNS_HubRegistry.label: Help URL
FNS_HubRegistry.help: The tool's wiki/help page; the hub offers it on the tab. Leave empty to skip.

FNS_HubRegistry.name: Promotepars
FNS_HubRegistry.label: Promote Parameters
FNS_HubRegistry.help: When on, the host mirrors its key Registration parameters onto the parent tool as a bound Registry page. Turn off before shipping a tool that should not expose registry controls.

FNS_HubRegistry.name: Presaveheal
FNS_HubRegistry.label: Pre-Save Heal
FNS_HubRegistry.help: Before each project save, re-check this registry: update entries whose component moved, drop entries whose component is gone, and republish a host that initialised before the global registry existed. Off skips the sweep for this registry only.

FNS_HubRegistry.name: Open
FNS_HubRegistry.label: Open Hub
FNS_HubRegistry.help: Open FNS_Hub (the toolkit's one-stop manager window) on this host's tab.

FNS_HydroHomie.name: Active
FNS_HydroHomie.label: Enable
FNS_HydroHomie.help: Turn the reminder on. Off by default. With it off the component sits in the toolbar and never interrupts you.

FNS_HydroHomie.name: Intervalminutes
FNS_HydroHomie.label: Interval minutes
FNS_HydroHomie.help: Minutes between reminders. 45 by default; the countdown restarts when you click the alert away.

FNS_HydroHomie.name: Lfofreq
FNS_HydroHomie.label: LFO Freq
FNS_HydroHomie.help: How fast the alert icon pulses, in Hz. Lower is calmer; this only affects the animation, never the interval.

FNS_HydroHomie.name: Onstartactive

FNS_HydroHomie.help: Start reminding as soon as the project opens, instead of waiting for Enable to be switched on by hand.

Idempotent: an existing DAT is adopted, never overwritten. The hooks are optional lifecycle notifications: onRegistered, onUnregistered, onDisplayChanged, onSideChanged.

FNS_MainMenuRegistry.name: Regstatus

FNS_MainMenuRegistry.help: Pin this entry into the gap directly AFTER a named stock menu-bar item (e.g. 'tutorials'), overriding the left/right side band. Resolved live each sync: a vanished anchor falls back to the side band and heals if the item returns. Empty = normal side placement.

FNS_MainMenuRegistry.name: Displayed
FNS_MainMenuRegistry.label: Displayed

FNS_MainMenuRegistry.name: Barwidth

FNS_MainMenuRegistry.help: Width of this widget in the toolbar. 0 = auto (follow the widget). Persisted here; the registry writes manager edits back.

FNS_MainMenuRegistry.name: Helpurl
FNS_MainMenuRegistry.label: Help URL

FNS_MainMenuRegistry.name: Promotepars

FNS_MainMenuRegistry.name: Presaveheal

FNS_MediaBrowser.name: Mediaui
FNS_MediaBrowser.label: Open Browser
FNS_MediaBrowser.help: Open the media browser panel (reference list + preview) in a floating viewer.

FNS_MediaBrowser.name: Mediascan
FNS_MediaBrowser.label: Rescan Media
FNS_MediaBrowser.help: Re-walk the project for media file references (movie / image / audio / geometry) and rebuild the browser list. Nothing is changed on disk or in the network.

FNS_MediaBrowser.name: Mediamissing
FNS_MediaBrowser.label: Missing Only
FNS_MediaBrowser.help: When on, the browser lists only references whose file is missing on disk - the broken ones you actually need to repoint.

FNS_MediaBrowser.name: Mediastatus
FNS_MediaBrowser.label: Media Status
FNS_MediaBrowser.help: Live readout of the last scan, hover, or replacement.

FNS_MixSequencer.name: Sequencer
FNS_MixSequencer.label: Sequencer
FNS_MixSequencer.help: The OpSequencer this matrix authors for. Used by Sync Columns (match the weight columns to its Length) and, later, the UI row labels. Playback needs only the CHOP: wire out1 into that sequencer's Weights CHOP with its Mode on Mix.

FNS_MixSequencer.name: Stepselect
FNS_MixSequencer.label: Step Select
FNS_MixSequencer.help: The playhead, in steps. Whole numbers are a step's weights exactly; fractions crossfade into the next step with its EASE curve; wraps over the step count. Drive it from a CHOP, the list, or Python; nothing in here owns a clock.

FNS_MixSequencer.name: Nextstep
FNS_MixSequencer.label: Next Step
FNS_MixSequencer.help: Step the playhead to the next whole step, wrapping.

FNS_MixSequencer.name: Prevstep
FNS_MixSequencer.label: Prev Step
FNS_MixSequencer.help: Step the playhead to the previous whole step, wrapping.

FNS_MixSequencer.name: Appendstep
FNS_MixSequencer.label: Append Step
FNS_MixSequencer.help: Append the playhead's CURRENT (eased) weight vector as a new last step. Sound a blend by scrubbing, then keep it.

FNS_MixSequencer.name: Removestep
FNS_MixSequencer.label: Remove Step
FNS_MixSequencer.help: Remove the step under the playhead.

FNS_MixSequencer.name: Initsteps
FNS_MixSequencer.label: Init Steps
FNS_MixSequencer.help: Wipe the sequence and leave one one-hot step on preset 0.

FNS_MixSequencer.name: Onehotpreset
FNS_MixSequencer.label: One-Hot Preset
FNS_MixSequencer.help: The preset index Set One-Hot writes into the step under the playhead.

FNS_MixSequencer.name: Onehotnow
FNS_MixSequencer.label: Set One-Hot
FNS_MixSequencer.help: Make the step under the playhead a pure recall of One-Hot Preset: 1 there, 0 everywhere else. A run of one-hot steps is a cue list: any preset, any order.

FNS_MixSequencer.name: Presetcount
FNS_MixSequencer.label: Preset Count
FNS_MixSequencer.help: How many weight columns (w0..wN) the steps carry, one per preset of the target sequencer, keyed by preset index. Trimming drops the highest indices.

FNS_MixSequencer.name: Synccolumns
FNS_MixSequencer.label: Sync Columns
FNS_MixSequencer.help: Set Preset Count from the Sequencer's Length.

FNS_MixSequencer.name: Steps
FNS_MixSequencer.label: Steps
FNS_MixSequencer.help: Read-only: number of steps in the sequence.

FNS_MixSequencer.name: Mixstatus
FNS_MixSequencer.label: Status
FNS_MixSequencer.help: Read-only: the last thing the matrix did for you.

FNS_MixSequencer.name: Stepsrepo
FNS_MixSequencer.label: Steps
FNS_MixSequencer.help: The table DAT holding the steps. By default the prefab inside this component, so sequences save with it. Create clones it next to this component and points here, so sequences live in your project (relocatable, externalizable, git-friendly).

FNS_MixSequencer.name: Stepsrepocreate
FNS_MixSequencer.label: Create
FNS_MixSequencer.help: Clone the steps table next to this component and point Steps at it.

FNS_NavbarRegistry.name: Kind
FNS_NavbarRegistry.label: Item Kind
FNS_NavbarRegistry.help: What the registered COMP is. Widget: a panel placed in the bar's left/right flow. Overlay: an out-of-flow panel (e.g. a click-through layer over the path cells), shown but never re-ordered. Logic: a non-panel COMP that just needs a running copy inside every pane bar.

FNS_NavbarRegistry.name: Displayed

FNS_NavbarRegistry.help: Before each project save, re-check this registry: update entries whose component moved, drop entries whose component is gone, and republish a host that initialised before the global registry existed. Off skips the sweep for this registry only.

FNS_OpenExt.name: Shortcuts
FNS_OpenExt.label: Shortcuts
FNS_OpenExt.help: Key that opens the selected COMP's promoted extension in your external editor. The default is an expression that picks the right keys per platform. Typing a plain value over it pins the tool to one OS.

FNS_OpFamily.name: Family
FNS_OpFamily.label: Family Name
FNS_OpFamily.help: The family name: the tab the operators appear under in the OP Create dialog.

FNS_OpFamily.name: Version
FNS_OpFamily.label: Version
FNS_OpFamily.help: The version of the family registry.

FNS_OpFamily.name: Install
FNS_OpFamily.label: Install
FNS_OpFamily.help: Install the family into the OP Create dialog.

FNS_OpFamily.name: Installonstart
FNS_OpFamily.label: Install On Start
FNS_OpFamily.help: Install the family every time the project opens.

FNS_OpFamily.name: Color
FNS_OpFamily.label: Color
FNS_OpFamily.help: The family's colour in the OP Create dialog and on its operators.

FNS_OpFamily.name: Index
FNS_OpFamily.label: Index
FNS_OpFamily.help: Position of the family's tab among the OP Create dialog's tabs.

FNS_OpFamily.name: Compatibletypes
FNS_OpFamily.label: Compatible Op Families
FNS_OpFamily.help: Which operator families the family's operators connect to, for filtering in the dialog.

FNS_OpFamily.name: Opcomp
FNS_OpFamily.label: Op Comp
FNS_OpFamily.help: The COMP holding the family's operators.

FNS_OpFamily.name: Createopcomp
FNS_OpFamily.label: Create Op Comp
FNS_OpFamily.help: Create an empty COMP for the family's operators and point Op Comp at it.

FNS_OpFamily.name: Opfolder
FNS_OpFamily.label: [ .tox ] Op Folder
FNS_OpFamily.help: A folder of .tox operators to add to the family.

FNS_OpFamily.name: Colorfileops
FNS_OpFamily.label: Color .tox from Folder
FNS_OpFamily.help: Colour the operators loaded from the folder in the family colour.

FNS_OpFamily.name: Namingconvention
FNS_OpFamily.label: Version Regex Match
FNS_OpFamily.help: How version numbers are read from .tox file names.

FNS_OpFamily.name: Ensuremanifests
FNS_OpFamily.label: Ensure Manifests
FNS_OpFamily.help: Give every operator in the family a manifest if it lacks one.

FNS_OpFamily.name: Famuicomp
FNS_OpFamily.label: FamUI COMP
FNS_OpFamily.help: The COMP that draws the family's UI in the dialog.

FNS_OpFamily.name: Createstuball
FNS_OpFamily.label: Create Stubs For All
FNS_OpFamily.help: Create a stub for every operator in the family.

FNS_OpFamily.name: Replacestuball
FNS_OpFamily.label: Replace Stubs For All
FNS_OpFamily.help: Replace every stub in the project with the current operator.

FNS_OpFamily.name: Updateall
FNS_OpFamily.label: Update All
FNS_OpFamily.help: Update every family operator in the project to the current version.

FNS_OpFamily.name: Targetop
FNS_OpFamily.label: Target Op
FNS_OpFamily.help: Operator to stub or stub to replace

FNS_OpFamily.name: Createstubop
FNS_OpFamily.label: Create Stub For Op
FNS_OpFamily.help: Create stub for target operator

FNS_OpFamily.name: Replacestubop
FNS_OpFamily.label: Replace Stub For Op
FNS_OpFamily.help: Replace target stub with full operator

FNS_OpFamily.name: Updateop
FNS_OpFamily.label: Update Op
FNS_OpFamily.help: Update the selected operator to the current version.

FNS_OpFamily.name: Targetcomp
FNS_OpFamily.label: Target Comp
FNS_OpFamily.help: Network container to process

FNS_OpFamily.name: Createstubscomp
FNS_OpFamily.label: Create Stubs In Comp
FNS_OpFamily.help: Stub all operators in target network

FNS_OpFamily.name: Replacestubcomp
FNS_OpFamily.label: Replace Stubs In Comp

FNS_OpFamily.name: Updatecomp
FNS_OpFamily.label: Update Ops In Comp
FNS_OpFamily.help: Update every family operator inside a COMP.

FNS_OpFamily.name: Targettype
FNS_OpFamily.label: Target Type
FNS_OpFamily.help: The operator type Update Type acts on.

FNS_OpFamily.name: Updatetype
FNS_OpFamily.label: Update Type
FNS_OpFamily.help: Update every placed operator of Target Type.

FNS_OpFamily.name: Callbackdat
FNS_OpFamily.label: Callback DAT

FNS_OpFamily.name: Createcallbacks

FNS_OpFamily.help: Create a callbacks DAT from the template and point Callback DAT at it.

FNS_OpFamily.name: About

FNS_OpFamily.help: Show the about text.

FNS_OpFamily.name: License
FNS_OpFamily.label: License
FNS_OpFamily.help: Show the license.

FNS_OpFamily.name: Devmode
FNS_OpFamily.label: Dev Mode

FNS_OpFamily.label: Support
