FNS_OpFamily.name: Tdfamcreators1support
FNS_OpFamily.label: Support
FNS_OpFamily.help: Open the support page of a TDFam creator.

FNS_OpMenuMods.name: Iofilteractive
FNS_OpMenuMods.label: IO Filter Active
FNS_OpMenuMods.help: Add Greg Hermanovic's IO filter buttons to the top right of the OP Create dialog: IO shows only operators that talk to something outside TouchDesigner, -IO hides them, All is the default.

FNS_OpMenuRegistry.name: Comp
FNS_OpMenuRegistry.label: Widget COMP
FNS_OpMenuRegistry.help: Panel COMP published as the toolbar widget. Defaults to the parent component.

FNS_OpMenuRegistry.name: Canonicalname
FNS_OpMenuRegistry.label: Canonical Name
FNS_OpMenuRegistry.help: Unique name for this widget in the global toolbar registry.

FNS_OpMenuRegistry.name: Callback
FNS_OpMenuRegistry.label: Callback DAT
FNS_OpMenuRegistry.help: Optional DAT with toolbar callbacks for this widget.

FNS_OpMenuRegistry.name: Createcallbacks
FNS_OpMenuRegistry.label: Create Callbacks
FNS_OpMenuRegistry.help: Spawn an 'opmenu_callbacks' DAT into this tool from the registry's template and wire this host's Callback parameter to it. Safe to pulse again: an existing DAT is adopted, never overwritten.

FNS_OpMenuRegistry.name: Panel
FNS_OpMenuRegistry.label: Panel
FNS_OpMenuRegistry.help: A Panel COMP to inject into /ui/dialogs/menu_op. The zero-code way to contribute a panel, with no callbacks DAT needed. Combined with anything onPanels() returns, not overridden by it.

FNS_OpMenuRegistry.name: Panelanchor
FNS_OpMenuRegistry.label: Panel Anchor
FNS_OpMenuRegistry.help: Name of a panel inside /ui/dialogs/menu_op whose output the injected panel's input is wired to. Without it the panel drops out of the dialog's layout flow. Default: searchpanel.

FNS_OpMenuRegistry.name: Autoregister
FNS_OpMenuRegistry.label: Auto-register
FNS_OpMenuRegistry.help: When on, keep this widget published into the global toolbar registry while this component exists.

FNS_OpMenuRegistry.name: Register
FNS_OpMenuRegistry.label: Register
FNS_OpMenuRegistry.help: Publish once into the global toolbar registry, even if Auto-register is off.

FNS_OpMenuRegistry.name: Unregister
FNS_OpMenuRegistry.label: Unregister
FNS_OpMenuRegistry.help: Take this tool's contribution back out of the registry and turn Autoregister off, so it stays out. Register puts it back.

FNS_OpMenuRegistry.name: Regstatus
FNS_OpMenuRegistry.label: Registration Status
FNS_OpMenuRegistry.help: Read-only status of this host registration.

FNS_OpMenuRegistry.name: Menuorder
FNS_OpMenuRegistry.label: Contribution Order
FNS_OpMenuRegistry.help: Preferred order among registered widgets, managed by the global registry. -1 = no preference (append at the end).

FNS_OpMenuRegistry.name: Displayed
FNS_OpMenuRegistry.label: Displayed
FNS_OpMenuRegistry.help: Default visibility of the widget in the toolbar (managed by the global registry).

FNS_OpMenuRegistry.name: Helpurl
FNS_OpMenuRegistry.label: Help URL
FNS_OpMenuRegistry.help: The tool's wiki/help page opened from the Configurator (right-click the Name cell). Leave empty to auto-discover from a docsHelper COMP (its Url par) inside the registered panel or its parent.

FNS_OpMenuRegistry.name: Promotepars
FNS_OpMenuRegistry.label: Promote Parameters
FNS_OpMenuRegistry.help: When on, the host mirrors its key Registration parameters onto the parent tool as a bound 'Registry' page. Turn off before shipping a tool that should not expose registry controls.

FNS_OpMenuRegistry.name: Presaveheal
FNS_OpMenuRegistry.label: Pre-Save Heal
FNS_OpMenuRegistry.help: Before each project save, re-check this registry: update entries whose component moved, drop entries whose component is gone, and republish a host that initialised before the global registry existed. Off skips the sweep for this registry only.

FNS_OpMenuRegistry.name: Shortcutalternatives
FNS_OpMenuRegistry.label: Alternatives Shortcut
FNS_OpMenuRegistry.help: Modifier keys to hold while creating an operator to be offered the alternatives registered for its type (space-separated: alt, ctrl, shift, cmd). Without the keys the operator is created as normal. Applies on the /sys global; the master holds the value the global is promoted with.

FNS_OpSequencer.name: Append
FNS_OpSequencer.label: Append
FNS_OpSequencer.help: Capture the current state as a new last preset.

FNS_OpSequencer.name: Replace
FNS_OpSequencer.label: Replace
FNS_OpSequencer.help: Overwrite the selected preset with the current state.

FNS_OpSequencer.name: Insert
FNS_OpSequencer.label: Insert
FNS_OpSequencer.help: Capture the current state after the selected preset, and select the new one.

FNS_OpSequencer.name: Remove
FNS_OpSequencer.label: Remove
FNS_OpSequencer.help: Delete the selected preset.

FNS_OpSequencer.name: Init
FNS_OpSequencer.label: Init
FNS_OpSequencer.help: Wipe all presets and capture the current state as the first one.

FNS_OpSequencer.name: Playmode
FNS_OpSequencer.label: Mode
FNS_OpSequencer.help: How the presets are played back. Select scrubs a playhead through the table, easing each preset into the next. A to B morphs between two chosen presets. Spline fits a periodic curve through every preset. Mix blends ALL of them at once by weight; see the Mix page.

FNS_OpSequencer.name: Override
FNS_OpSequencer.label: Override
FNS_OpSequencer.help: On: the Easing menu applies to every transition. Off: each preset's own easing is used.

FNS_OpSequencer.name: Easing
FNS_OpSequencer.label: Easing
FNS_OpSequencer.help: The curve transitions follow: 31 easings, or CustomEase, which reads the curve from the first CHOP input.

FNS_OpSequencer.name: Rotmode
FNS_OpSequencer.label: Rotation Blend
FNS_OpSequencer.help: How rotation triples (rx/ry/rz, Rotx/Roty/Rotz...) and single angle columns (rotate, roll, hue, phase...) blend between presets. Euler (legacy): each channel eased on its own, exactly as before. Slerp (shortest): triples blended in quaternion space and angles along the shortest arc - a 0 to 350 deg yaw now turns -10 deg, not +350. Slerp (preserve winding): quaternion blend for triples, but any sweep authored beyond 180 deg keeps going the long way; single angles follow the authored sweep.

FNS_OpSequencer.name: Rotgroups
FNS_OpSequencer.label: Rotation Groups
FNS_OpSequencer.help: Extra rotation tuplet bases to blend as quaternions, space separated and case-exact (e.g. "Spin Tilt" for Spinx Spiny Spinz and Tiltx Tilty Tiltz). Complete x/y/z triples named r, R, Rot, Rotate or Rotation (any case) are detected automatically. Only complete triples are grouped.

FNS_OpSequencer.name: Periodic
FNS_OpSequencer.label: Periodic Columns
FNS_OpSequencer.help: Single angle-like columns to blend along the shortest arc, space separated and case-exact, as name or name:period (e.g. "Twist Offset:1"). rotate, roll, angle*, hue* and a lone rx/Rotz are detected automatically as degrees (360), phase* as 0..1. Applies in the Slerp blend modes; Euler (legacy) leaves them as plain numbers.

FNS_OpSequencer.name: Select
FNS_OpSequencer.label: Select
FNS_OpSequencer.help: The playhead: whole numbers recall a preset, values between blend toward the next one. It wraps around.

FNS_OpSequencer.name: Select1
FNS_OpSequencer.label: Preset A
FNS_OpSequencer.help: In A to B mode: the preset the morph starts from.

FNS_OpSequencer.name: Select2
FNS_OpSequencer.label: Preset B
FNS_OpSequencer.help: In A to B mode: the preset the morph ends at.

FNS_OpSequencer.name: Selany
FNS_OpSequencer.label: Select
FNS_OpSequencer.help: In A to B mode: the position of the morph from Preset A (0) to Preset B (1).

FNS_OpSequencer.name: Length
FNS_OpSequencer.label: Length
FNS_OpSequencer.help: Read-only: the number of presets.

FNS_OpSequencer.name: Op
FNS_OpSequencer.label: OP
FNS_OpSequencer.help: The operator whose parameters are sequenced. Dropping an operator on the panel sets it too.

FNS_OpSequencer.name: Bind
FNS_OpSequencer.label: Bind
FNS_OpSequencer.help: Off stops the sequencer writing to the target; the values stay where they are.

FNS_OpSequencer.name: Reset
FNS_OpSequencer.label: Reset
FNS_OpSequencer.help: Wipe the presets table and its columns. The previous table is backed up.

FNS_OpSequencer.name: Prunestale
FNS_OpSequencer.label: Prune Stale Columns
FNS_OpSequencer.help: Drop preset columns whose parameter no longer exists on the target operator (e.g. a custom parameter deleted in the Component Editor). The table is backed up first; RestorePresets() undoes it.

FNS_OpSequencer.name: Presetsrepo
FNS_OpSequencer.label: Presets
FNS_OpSequencer.help: Where the presets table lives. Empty keeps it inside the sequencer.

FNS_OpSequencer.name: Presetsrepocreate
FNS_OpSequencer.label: Create
FNS_OpSequencer.help: Create a presets table outside the sequencer and point Presets at it.

FNS_OpSequencer.name: Mixsource
FNS_OpSequencer.label: Weights From
FNS_OpSequencer.help: Where the per-preset weights come from. Parameters: the Mix blocks below. CHOP: the Weights CHOP, one value per preset. Parameters x CHOP: the blocks act as a per-preset trim or enable and the CHOP drives on top of them.

FNS_OpSequencer.name: Mixchop
FNS_OpSequencer.label: Weights
FNS_OpSequencer.help: CHOP carrying the mix weights, one value per preset. Leave blank to use whatever is wired into the component's second CHOP input.

FNS_OpSequencer.name: Mixmap
FNS_OpSequencer.label: Map
FNS_OpSequencer.help: How the source values land on the presets. Exact: one value per preset, extra values trimmed and missing presets left at zero, for a fader bank that matches the table. Stretch: the source is resampled across the whole table, so a handful of channels smear over every preset.

FNS_OpSequencer.name: Mixaxis
FNS_OpSequencer.label: Read
FNS_OpSequencer.help: Which axis of the source CHOP carries the weights. Auto reads the samples of a single-channel CHOP, and one value per channel for anything else.

FNS_OpSequencer.name: Mixpopulate
FNS_OpSequencer.label: Populate All Presets
FNS_OpSequencer.help: Rebuild the Mix blocks as one per preset, in order. Weights already dialled for a preset are preserved.

FNS_OpSequencer.name: Mixclear
FNS_OpSequencer.label: Clear Blocks
FNS_OpSequencer.help: Drop back to a single empty block. Use it to mix a handful of presets instead of the whole table.

FNS_OpSequencer.name: Mix
FNS_OpSequencer.label: Mix
FNS_OpSequencer.help: In Mix mode: one weight block per preset; all presets blend at once by weight.

FNS_OpSequencer.name: Mix0preset
FNS_OpSequencer.label: Preset
FNS_OpSequencer.help: Which preset this block weights, by its index in the list.

FNS_OpSequencer.name: Mix0weight
FNS_OpSequencer.label: Weight
FNS_OpSequencer.help: How hard this preset pulls. Relative to the other blocks under Normalize; a share of 1 under Base residual.

FNS_OpSequencer.name: Patreon
FNS_OpSequencer.label: Patreon
FNS_OpSequencer.help: Open Function Store's Patreon page.

FNS_OpSequencer.name: Readme
FNS_OpSequencer.label: Open README
FNS_OpSequencer.help: Open the README: workflow, every parameter, the preset list, rotation blending and the presets table.

FNS_OpSequencer.name: Easepreset
FNS_OpSequencer.label: Preset
FNS_OpSequencer.help: The preset these controls edit. Follows the selected row.

FNS_OpSequencer.name: Baseease
FNS_OpSequencer.label: Base Easing
FNS_OpSequencer.help: Easing used when morphing INTO the selected preset. Every parameter without an override below follows this curve.

FNS_OpSequencer.name: Ovr
FNS_OpSequencer.label: Overrides
FNS_OpSequencer.help: The selected preset's easing overrides: one block per parameter eased with its own curve.

FNS_OpSequencer.name: Ovr0par
FNS_OpSequencer.label: Parameter
FNS_OpSequencer.help: Parameter this override re-eases (- = row inactive). Rotation triples appear as their base name and ease as one arc.

FNS_OpSequencer.name: Ovr0ease
FNS_OpSequencer.label: Easing
FNS_OpSequencer.help: Easing curve for this parameter alone, morphing into the selected preset.

FNS_OpSequencer.name: Clearovr
FNS_OpSequencer.label: Clear Overrides
FNS_OpSequencer.help: Remove every per-parameter override from the selected preset; the base easing stays.

FNS_OpSequencer.name: Showeasing
FNS_OpSequencer.label: Show Easing Panel
FNS_OpSequencer.help: Show or hide the easing strip in the panel UI.

FNS_OpTemplates.name: Target
FNS_OpTemplates.label: Root
FNS_OpTemplates.help: The component whose network is watched for newly created operators. '/' watches the whole project; narrow it if you want templates to apply in one branch only.

FNS_OpTemplates.name: Libraryscope
FNS_OpTemplates.label: Library Scope
FNS_OpTemplates.help: Where the active templates library lives. Global: one .tox in your user palette folder, shared by every project on this machine. Project: a component at the network root outside FNSTools, saved with this .toe and kept across toolkit updates. Follow: whatever the toolkit's Config Scope says. A missing library is created from the set that is loaded now; the shipped templates are only the seed.

FNS_OpTemplates.name: Templates
FNS_OpTemplates.label: Templates
FNS_OpTemplates.help: The library the scope resolved to. Read-only: change Library Scope instead.

FNS_OpTemplates.name: Opentemplates
FNS_OpTemplates.label: Open Templates
FNS_OpTemplates.help: Open the templates component in a floating network, to add or edit templates by hand.

FNS_OpTemplates.name: Savetemplates
FNS_OpTemplates.label: Save Templates
FNS_OpTemplates.help: Write the templates to disk: to the external .tox when External is on, otherwise by saving the project. It confirms first, because it overwrites what is already there.

FNS_OpTemplates.name: Pushtoglobal
FNS_OpTemplates.label: Push To Global
FNS_OpTemplates.help: Write the active library to the global palette file, so a set built in this project becomes the one every project on this machine loads. Asks before overwriting an existing file.

FNS_OpTemplates.name: Refreshtemplates
FNS_OpTemplates.label: Refresh Templates
FNS_OpTemplates.help: Reload the templates component from its external .tox, discarding unsaved edits made in this session.

FNS_OpTemplates.name: Keys
FNS_OpTemplates.label: Keys
FNS_OpTemplates.help: Mirrors the Alternatives Shortcut on FNS_OpMenuRegistry, which is where the alternatives are offered from now. Change it there.

FNS_OpToClipboard.name: Active
FNS_OpToClipboard.label: Active
FNS_OpToClipboard.help: Turn OpToClipboard on or off. When on, the copy shortcut puts the selected operator's reference on the clipboard ready to paste into an expression. Off leaves the component installed but idle.

FNS_OpToClipboard.name: Shortcut
FNS_OpToClipboard.label: Shortcut
FNS_OpToClipboard.help: Hotkey that copies the selected operator's reference to the clipboard.

FNS_Output.name: Performwindow
FNS_Output.label: Perform Window
FNS_Output.help: The Window COMP these tools drive. Dropping an operator on the toolbar button sets that window's Window Operator, and the streaming switches below follow the same window.

FNS_Output.name: Spoutactive
FNS_Output.label: Spout Active
FNS_Output.help: Stream the perform window to other applications on this machine over Spout (Windows) or Syphon (macOS).

FNS_Output.name: Sendername
FNS_Output.label: Sender Name
FNS_Output.help: The name other applications see this Spout/Syphon stream under. Change it when two TouchDesigner instances would otherwise publish the same name.

FNS_Output.name: Ndiactive
FNS_Output.label: NDI Active
FNS_Output.help: Stream the perform window over NDI, so machines on the same network can receive it.

FNS_Output.name: Name
FNS_Output.label: NDI Source Name
FNS_Output.help: The NDI source name this machine publishes. It is what receivers pick from their source list, so make it identifiable when several machines are streaming.

FNS_PaletteRegistry.name: Comp
FNS_PaletteRegistry.label: Tool COMP
FNS_PaletteRegistry.help: The tool that contributes this tab. Defaults to the parent component (the host lives inside the tool it publishes).

FNS_PaletteRegistry.name: Canonicalname
FNS_PaletteRegistry.label: Canonical Name
FNS_PaletteRegistry.help: Unique name of the tab (letters, digits, _ -). Leave empty to use the tool COMP name. "palette" is TD's own tab and cannot be taken.

FNS_PaletteRegistry.name: Panel
FNS_PaletteRegistry.label: Tab Panel
FNS_PaletteRegistry.help: The panel COMP shown when this tab is selected. Shown in place through a Select COMP, never copied, and sized to the tab slot by the registry (its w/h become slot expressions while registered). Defaults to the tool itself.

FNS_PaletteRegistry.name: Callback
FNS_PaletteRegistry.label: Callbacks DAT
FNS_PaletteRegistry.help: Optional Python DAT. onPaletteTab(canonical, previous) fires on every tab change so the tool can react (e.g. route a shared panel). Raise-contained.

FNS_PaletteRegistry.name: Autoregister
FNS_PaletteRegistry.label: Expose in Palette
FNS_PaletteRegistry.help: Publish this tab into TouchDesigner's Palette Browser while the component exists. Off = the tool contributes nothing.

FNS_PaletteRegistry.name: Register
FNS_PaletteRegistry.label: Register
FNS_PaletteRegistry.help: Publish once into the Palette Browser, even if Expose is off.

FNS_PaletteRegistry.name: Unregister
FNS_PaletteRegistry.label: Unregister
FNS_PaletteRegistry.help: Take this tool's contribution back out of the registry and turn Autoregister off, so it stays out. Register puts it back.

FNS_PaletteRegistry.name: Regstatus
FNS_PaletteRegistry.label: Registration Status
FNS_PaletteRegistry.help: Read-only status of this host registration.

FNS_PaletteRegistry.name: Displayed
FNS_PaletteRegistry.label: Shown in Palette
FNS_PaletteRegistry.help: Show this tab on the Palette Browser's tab strip. Off keeps it registered but hidden; the registry writes its choice back here so it persists with the tool.

FNS_PaletteRegistry.name: Tablabel
FNS_PaletteRegistry.label: Tab Label
FNS_PaletteRegistry.help: What the tab strip shows. Empty = the canonical name.

FNS_PaletteRegistry.name: Taborder
FNS_PaletteRegistry.label: Tab Order
FNS_PaletteRegistry.help: Position on the strip after TD's own Palette tab (always first). Contributions default to 50 and sort by this, then by label.

FNS_PaletteRegistry.name: Helpurl
FNS_PaletteRegistry.label: Help URL
FNS_PaletteRegistry.help: The tool's wiki/help page. Informational; leave empty to skip.

FNS_PaletteRegistry.name: Promotepars
FNS_PaletteRegistry.label: Promote Parameters
FNS_PaletteRegistry.help: When on, the host mirrors its key Registration parameters onto the parent tool as a bound Registry page (Pl* pars). Turn off before shipping a tool that should not expose registry controls.

FNS_PaletteRegistry.name: Presaveheal
FNS_PaletteRegistry.label: Pre-Save Heal
FNS_PaletteRegistry.help: Before each project save, re-check this registry: update entries whose component moved, drop entries whose component is gone, and republish a host that initialised before the global registry existed. Off skips the sweep for this registry only.

FNS_PaletteRegistry.name: Tab
FNS_PaletteRegistry.label: Extra Tabs
FNS_PaletteRegistry.help: Additional tabs published by this one host. The Registration pars above define the FIRST tab; each block here adds one more, so a tool can put several tabs on the strip (optionally over the same panel) without stamping a second host.

FNS_PaletteRegistry.name: Tab0name
FNS_PaletteRegistry.label: Canonical Name
FNS_PaletteRegistry.help: Unique name of this extra tab (letters, digits, _ -). Required; the block is skipped while it is empty. "palette" is TD's own tab and cannot be taken.

FNS_PaletteRegistry.name: Tab0source
FNS_PaletteRegistry.label: Tab Panel
FNS_PaletteRegistry.help: Panel COMP shown for this tab. Leave empty to reuse the Tab Panel above. That is how one panel serves several tabs, routed by onPaletteTab.

FNS_PaletteRegistry.name: Tab0label
FNS_PaletteRegistry.label: Tab Label
FNS_PaletteRegistry.help: What the tab strip shows for this tab. Empty = the canonical name.

FNS_PaletteRegistry.name: Tab0order
FNS_PaletteRegistry.label: Tab Order
FNS_PaletteRegistry.help: Position on the strip after TD's own Palette tab. Contributions sort by this, then by label.

FNS_PaletteRegistry.name: Tab0shown
FNS_PaletteRegistry.label: Shown in Palette
FNS_PaletteRegistry.help: Show this tab on the strip. Off keeps it registered but hidden.

FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.name: Comp
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.label: COMP
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.help: COMP to register as the pane owner. Defaults to parent (..). PANEL requires a Panel COMP (isPanel); other pane types accept any COMP.

FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.name: Canonicalname
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.label: Canonical Name
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.help: Name shown in the panebar menu. Leave empty to use the host COMP name.

FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.name: Callback
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.label: Callback
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.help: Optional Text DAT with onPaneRecall(ctx). Invoked after built-in recall actions. Use Create Callback for a skeleton.

FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.name: Createcallbacks
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.label: Create Callback
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.help: Create a callbacks Text DAT with a default onPaneRecall(ctx) skeleton and assign it to Callback. Will not overwrite non-empty existing callbacks text.

FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.name: Autoregister
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.label: Auto-register
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.help: When on, register the host COMP immediately and keep recall flags / callback in sync when settings change. When off, use Register or Python RegisterPanel.

FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.name: Register
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.label: Register
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.help: Register the host COMP now (even if Auto-register is off). Validates COMP type against Pane Type.

FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.name: Unregister
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.label: Unregister
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.help: Take this tool's contribution back out of the registry and turn Autoregister off, so it stays out. Register puts it back.

FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.name: Regstatus
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.label: Status
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.help: Read-only status of host auto-registration (Idle, Registered, Skipped under /sys or /ui, Error).

FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.name: Menuorder
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.label: Menu Order
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.help: Preferred order among registered panebar entries. -1 = no preference (append, default). 0 = first among custom entries, 1 = second, and so on. Built-in rows are not moved.

FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.name: Panetype
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.label: Pane Type
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.help: Pane type applied when this entry is selected in the panebar. PANEL is typical for containerCOMP UIs.

FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.name: Setowner
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.label: Set Owner
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.help: When on, set the pane owner to the registered COMP when this entry is selected.

FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.name: Changetype
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.label: Change Type
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.help: When on, change the pane to the selected Pane Type. changeType returns a new Pane object; Maximize/Float/Callback run after.

FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.name: Maximize
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.label: Maximize
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.help: When on, maximize the pane after recall (pane.maximize = True).

FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.name: Tearaway
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.label: Tear Away
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.help: When on, tear the pane into a floating window after recall (pane.tearAway()).

FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.name: Float
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.label: Float
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.help: Open the registered COMP in a floating window. PANEL/Geometry/TOP/CHOP -> openViewer(); PARAMETERS -> openParameters(); Network Editor and other tool types -> showInPane Floating.

FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.name: Openparameters
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.label: Open Parameters
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.help: When on, open a floating parameter dialog for the registered COMP (op.openParameters()). Available for any pane type.

FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.name: Promotepars
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.label: Promote Parameters
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.help: When on, the host mirrors its key Registration parameters onto the parent tool as a bound 'Registry' page. Turn off before shipping a tool that should not expose registry controls.

FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.name: Presaveheal
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.label: Pre-Save Heal
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.help: Before each project save, re-check this registry: update entries whose component moved, drop entries whose component is gone, and republish a host that initialised before the global registry existed. Off skips the sweep for this registry only.

FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.name: Viewreadme
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.label: View Readme
FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.help: Open the PaneTypeRegistry developer README as a styled markdown annotate in this network (uses the bundled md viewer).

FNS_ParOPDrop.name: Active
FNS_ParOPDrop.label: Active
FNS_ParOPDrop.help: Turn ParOPDrop on or off. When on, dragging a custom parameter onto the toolbar button (or pressing its hotkey over one) creates the matching Par CHOP, Par DAT or ParExec DAT inside the COMP. Off leaves the component installed but idle.

FNS_ParOPDrop.name: Keys
FNS_ParOPDrop.label: Key
FNS_ParOPDrop.help: Key held to drop an operator reference onto a parameter. Modifiers are ignored.

FNS_ParRandomizer.name: Active
FNS_ParRandomizer.label: Active
FNS_ParRandomizer.help: Turn ParRandomizer on or off. When on, the toolbar button, drag-and-drop and the shortcuts below randomize parameters. Off leaves the component installed but idle.

FNS_ParRandomizer.name: Shortcutop
FNS_ParRandomizer.label: Shortcut Randomize OP
FNS_ParRandomizer.help: Key that randomizes every value slider on the selected operator.

FNS_ParRandomizer.name: Shortcutpar
FNS_ParRandomizer.label: Shortcut Randomize Rollover Par
FNS_ParRandomizer.help: Key that randomizes just the parameter the mouse is over.

FNS_ParRandomizer.name: Shortcutreset
FNS_ParRandomizer.label: Shortcut Reset Parameter
FNS_ParRandomizer.help: Key that puts the parameter under the mouse back to its default.

FNS_ParRandomizer.name: Shortcutresetallcustom
FNS_ParRandomizer.label: Shortcut Reset All Custom
FNS_ParRandomizer.help: Key that puts every parameter on the hovered parameter's page back to its default.

FNS_PreviewPanel.name: Restubt3d
FNS_PreviewPanel.label: Restub T3D
FNS_PreviewPanel.help: Development: ask the T3D family to replace the 3D viewer operator with a fresh stub.

FNS_PreviewPanel.name: Stubt3d
FNS_PreviewPanel.label: Stub T3D
FNS_PreviewPanel.help: Development: ask the T3D family to create a stub operator for the 3D viewer.

FNS_ProSceneChanger.name: Active
FNS_ProSceneChanger.label: Active
FNS_ProSceneChanger.help: Master switch. Off: no transitions happen, every scene COMP is allowed to cook and node colours are restored. On: reconciles to the current Select.

FNS_ProSceneChanger.name: Select
FNS_ProSceneChanger.label: Select
FNS_ProSceneChanger.help: Index of the scene to show, counting from 0; Loop Type decides what happens outside 0..Num Scenes-1. Drive it with a constant, an expression, a bind or a CHOP export. A change during a running transition restarts it toward the new scene; choosing the visible scene cancels it.

FNS_ProSceneChanger.name: Selectmenu
FNS_ProSceneChanger.label: Select Menu
FNS_ProSceneChanger.help: Pick the scene by name. Mirrors Select when Select is a constant or bind.

FNS_ProSceneChanger.name: Looptype
FNS_ProSceneChanger.label: Loop Type
FNS_ProSceneChanger.help: How Select values outside 0..Num Scenes-1 are handled: Clamp holds at the ends, Loop wraps around (modulo), Zigzag bounces back and forth.

FNS_ProSceneChanger.name: Currentselect
FNS_ProSceneChanger.label: Current Select
FNS_ProSceneChanger.help: Read-only: the scene currently visible (updated when a transition completes).

FNS_ProSceneChanger.name: Numscenes
FNS_ProSceneChanger.label: Num Scenes
FNS_ProSceneChanger.help: Read-only: the number of scenes, one per Inputs block (a wired connector or a TOP / COMP reference).

FNS_ProSceneChanger.name: Progress
FNS_ProSceneChanger.label: Progress
FNS_ProSceneChanger.help: Read-only: 0-1 progress of the running transition (across both halves in Fade Through Black).

FNS_ProSceneChanger.name: Finishtransition
FNS_ProSceneChanger.label: Finish Transition
FNS_ProSceneChanger.help: Complete the switch under way right now: a running crossfade or fade lands on its target, a Pre-Roll cuts straight to the scene it was warming, and a half-moved A/B Fader completes. Does nothing when idle. Python: FinishTransition().

FNS_ProSceneChanger.name: Switchmode
FNS_ProSceneChanger.label: Switch Mode
FNS_ProSceneChanger.help: How a scene change is performed. Crossfade blends over Crossfade Length; Fade Through Black fades the old scene out (Fade Out Time) then the new in (Fade In Time); Cut switches instantly; the two A/B Fader modes are driven by the Fader parameter like a DJ crossfader: the end the Fader rests at shows the current scene, moving it to the other end switches to the Select scene, and that end becomes the new resting end.

FNS_ProSceneChanger.name: Length
FNS_ProSceneChanger.label: Crossfade Length
FNS_ProSceneChanger.help: Duration in seconds of a crossfade (Switch Mode = Crossfade). A scene COMP with a 'Fadeintime' custom parameter overrides it for that scene.

FNS_ProSceneChanger.name: Easing
FNS_ProSceneChanger.label: Easing
FNS_ProSceneChanger.help: Easing curve for timed transitions: the crossfade, and both halves of Fade Through Black. Not used by the A/B Fader modes. A scene COMP can override it with Fadeincurve / Fadeoutcurve custom parameters.

FNS_ProSceneChanger.name: Fadeouttime
FNS_ProSceneChanger.label: Fade Out Time
FNS_ProSceneChanger.help: Seconds to fade the outgoing scene to black in Fade Through Black mode. A scene COMP with its own 'Fadeouttime' custom parameter overrides this.

FNS_ProSceneChanger.name: Fadeintime
FNS_ProSceneChanger.label: Fade In Time
FNS_ProSceneChanger.help: Seconds to fade the incoming scene up from black in Fade Through Black mode. A scene COMP with its own 'Fadeintime' custom parameter overrides this (in Crossfade mode it overrides Crossfade Length).

FNS_ProSceneChanger.name: Fadestyle
FNS_ProSceneChanger.label: Fade Style
FNS_ProSceneChanger.help: What 'black' means in Fade Through Black mode: To Black drives RGB to black and keeps alpha (opaque black); To Transparent fades opacity so the output becomes transparent.

FNS_ProSceneChanger.name: Fader
FNS_ProSceneChanger.label: A/B Fader
FNS_ProSceneChanger.help: Manual transition control in the A/B Fader modes. Whichever end (0 or 1) the Fader rests at is the current scene. Set Select to the next scene, then move the Fader to the opposite end: the blend (or the fade through black) follows the Fader and the switch completes on arrival, so the opposite end becomes the new resting end. Turning back before arriving cancels; changing Select mid-way re-targets. Drive it from a physical fader or a CHOP.

FNS_ProSceneChanger.name: Auto
FNS_ProSceneChanger.label: Auto Advance
FNS_ProSceneChanger.help: Switch to the next scene every Interval. Off pauses the countdown where it is; choosing a scene by hand (Select, Select Menu, Switch()) restarts it from that scene.

FNS_ProSceneChanger.name: Autoadvanceon
FNS_ProSceneChanger.label: Advance On
FNS_ProSceneChanger.help: Timer: switch every Interval. A/B Fader: each time the A/B Fader completes a switch, Select moves to the next scene (in Order and Direction), so the next push of the Fader goes there. Only in the two A/B Fader modes.

FNS_ProSceneChanger.name: Autointerval
FNS_ProSceneChanger.label: Interval
FNS_ProSceneChanger.help: Seconds between switches, the transition included: every Interval the next scene starts to arrive.

FNS_ProSceneChanger.name: Autoorder
FNS_ProSceneChanger.label: Order
FNS_ProSceneChanger.help: Sequential steps through the scenes in Direction; Loop Type decides the ends (Clamp stops, Loop wraps, Zigzag turns round). Random shows every other scene once, in a shuffled order, before any repeats.

FNS_ProSceneChanger.name: Autodirection
FNS_ProSceneChanger.label: Direction
FNS_ProSceneChanger.help: Sequential order: step to the next (Forward) or previous (Back) scene index.

FNS_ProSceneChanger.name: Autoseed
FNS_ProSceneChanger.label: Random Seed
FNS_ProSceneChanger.help: Random order: the same seed always gives the same sequence of shuffles.

FNS_ProSceneChanger.name: Autonext
FNS_ProSceneChanger.label: Next Switch In
FNS_ProSceneChanger.help: Read-only: seconds until Auto Advance switches.

FNS_ProSceneChanger.name: Res
FNS_ProSceneChanger.label: Res
FNS_ProSceneChanger.help: Output resolution of the changer: width and height in pixels.

FNS_ProSceneChanger.name: Inputs
FNS_ProSceneChanger.label: Inputs
FNS_ProSceneChanger.help: The scenes, one block each. Add blocks for more scenes; each block is one scene index, counting from 0.

FNS_ProSceneChanger.name: Inputs0top
FNS_ProSceneChanger.label: TOP
FNS_ProSceneChanger.help: Scene source: a TOP is shown as it is; a COMP shows its Out TOP, otherwise a display-flagged TOP inside it, otherwise its right-most TOP. A reference takes precedence over a wire on the same input connector.

FNS_ProSceneChanger.name: Inputs1top
FNS_ProSceneChanger.label: TOP
FNS_ProSceneChanger.help: Scene source: a TOP is shown as it is; a COMP shows its Out TOP, otherwise a display-flagged TOP inside it, otherwise its right-most TOP. A reference takes precedence over a wire on the same input connector.

FNS_ProSceneChanger.name: Inputs2top
FNS_ProSceneChanger.label: TOP
FNS_ProSceneChanger.help: Scene source: a TOP is shown as it is; a COMP shows its Out TOP, otherwise a display-flagged TOP inside it, otherwise its right-most TOP. A reference takes precedence over a wire on the same input connector.

FNS_ProSceneChanger.name: Controlcook
FNS_ProSceneChanger.label: Control Cook
FNS_ProSceneChanger.help: When on, only the scenes that need to cook are allowed to: the visible one, the incoming one during a transition, one warming up for its Pre-Roll and ones still in their Outro. Every other scene COMP has cooking disabled. Bare TOP scenes are never touched.

FNS_ProSceneChanger.name: Preroll
FNS_ProSceneChanger.label: Pre-Roll (start cooking before switch)
FNS_ProSceneChanger.help: Seconds the target scene cooks before its transition starts. When Select changes, the target COMP is allowed to cook immediately and the switch itself is delayed by this much, so feedback loops, movies or particle systems are warm when they appear. Changing Select again during the pre-roll re-targets it; choosing the visible scene cancels it. In the A/B Fader modes any value above 0 simply warms the chosen scene as soon as Select changes.

FNS_ProSceneChanger.name: Outro
FNS_ProSceneChanger.label: Outro (keep cooking after switch)
FNS_ProSceneChanger.help: Seconds the outgoing scene keeps cooking after the switch has completed, so an exit animation can finish off-screen. When the time is up the scene is uncooked and unloaded as usual (unless it has become visible again).

FNS_ProSceneChanger.name: Unload
FNS_ProSceneChanger.label: Unload
FNS_ProSceneChanger.help: When a scene stops cooking, release its CPU/GPU memory (TOPs, CHOPs, SOPs, movie caches) and free POP GPU memory, paced by Unload Budget.

FNS_ProSceneChanger.name: Unloadmethod
FNS_ProSceneChanger.label: Unload Method
FNS_ProSceneChanger.help: How an uncooked scene's memory is released. Progressive uses COMP.progressiveUnload() paced by Unload Budget and covers every node type including POPs. Immediate calls unload() on each unlocked TOP in a single frame.

FNS_ProSceneChanger.name: Unloadbudget
FNS_ProSceneChanger.label: Unload Budget (ms/frame)
FNS_ProSceneChanger.help: Milliseconds per frame spent releasing an uncooked scene's CPU/GPU memory (COMP.progressiveUnload). Spreads the unload over several frames so a heavy scene never hitches the frame it stops cooking. 0 unloads everything in a single frame.

FNS_ProSceneChanger.name: Reverseinputs
FNS_ProSceneChanger.label: Reverse Inputs
FNS_ProSceneChanger.help: Reconnect the wired inputs in reverse order. Applies to inputs wired into the connectors, not to the Inputs sequence TOP references.

FNS_ProSceneChanger.name: Randomizeinputs
FNS_ProSceneChanger.label: Randomize Inputs
FNS_ProSceneChanger.help: Reconnect the wired inputs in a random order.

FNS_ProSceneChanger.name: Nodeytoorder
FNS_ProSceneChanger.label: NodeY to Order (reconnect)
FNS_ProSceneChanger.help: Reconnect the wired inputs so the input order matches their top-to-bottom position in the network editor.

FNS_ProSceneChanger.name: Ordertonodey
FNS_ProSceneChanger.label: Order to NodeY (swap)
FNS_ProSceneChanger.help: Swap the wired inputs' node positions so top-to-bottom matches the input order (input 0 on top).

FNS_ProSceneChanger.name: Positiontoorder
FNS_ProSceneChanger.label: ^ automatic
FNS_ProSceneChanger.help: Keep NodeY to Order applied automatically: whenever a wired input COMP is moved in the network editor, the inputs are reconnected to match.

FNS_ProSceneChanger.name: Aligninputs
FNS_ProSceneChanger.label: Align Inputs (retoggle)
FNS_ProSceneChanger.help: While on, the wired input COMPs are kept stacked in one column beside the changer (input 0 on top) using Alignment Mode and Adjust Offset; changing either re-aligns immediately, and so does a wiring change. Turn it off and on again to re-align after moving things by hand.

FNS_ProSceneChanger.name: Alignmentmode
FNS_ProSceneChanger.label: Alignment Mode
FNS_ProSceneChanger.help: Where the column sits relative to the changer: Top aligns the first input with the changer's top edge, Center centres the column, Bottom aligns the last input with the changer's bottom edge.

FNS_ProSceneChanger.name: Adjust
FNS_ProSceneChanger.label: Adjust Offset (X, Y, YGap)
FNS_ProSceneChanger.help: Align Inputs offsets in network units: X offset of the column from the changer, Y offset, and the vertical gap between inputs.

FNS_ProSceneChanger.name: Colorize
FNS_ProSceneChanger.label: Colorize Scenes
FNS_ProSceneChanger.help: Tint the scene COMPs in the network editor: the visible (and incoming) scene gets On Color, the others Off Color. Original colours are restored when turned off.

FNS_ProSceneChanger.name: Oncolor
FNS_ProSceneChanger.label: On Color
FNS_ProSceneChanger.help: Node colour of the visible scene COMP while Colorize is on.

FNS_ProSceneChanger.name: Offcolor
FNS_ProSceneChanger.label: Off Color
FNS_ProSceneChanger.help: Node colour of the idle scene COMPs while Colorize is on.

FNS_ProSceneChanger.name: Keeporiginal
FNS_ProSceneChanger.label: Off = Keep Original Color
FNS_ProSceneChanger.help: When on, idle scenes get their own original node colour back instead of Off Color. The original colour of each scene COMP is remembered the first time it is tinted, so it can always be restored.

FNS_ProSceneChanger.name: Callbacks
FNS_ProSceneChanger.label: Callbacks
FNS_ProSceneChanger.help: The DAT holding your callback functions (onPrerollStart, onTransitionStart, onSelectionChange, ...). It points at the built-in template, which does nothing, until you use Create Callbacks.

FNS_ProSceneChanger.name: Createcallbacks
FNS_ProSceneChanger.label: Create Callbacks
FNS_ProSceneChanger.help: Create an editable callbacks DAT next to the changer, with every callback documented inside, and point Callbacks at it.

FNS_ProSceneChanger.name: Opendocs
FNS_ProSceneChanger.label: Open Documentation
FNS_ProSceneChanger.help: Open the built-in documentation (the 'help' Text DAT inside the component) in a viewer window.

FNS_QuickCollapse.name: Active
FNS_QuickCollapse.label: Active
FNS_QuickCollapse.help: Turn QuickCollapse on or off. When on, the shortcuts below collapse the selected nodes into a Base COMP. Off leaves the component installed but idle.

FNS_QuickCollapse.name: Shortcut
FNS_QuickCollapse.label: Shortcut
FNS_QuickCollapse.help: Key that collapses the selected nodes into a new Base COMP straight away, with no dialog.

FNS_QuickCollapse.name: Shortcutcustomize
FNS_QuickCollapse.label: Shortcut Customize
FNS_QuickCollapse.help: Key that collapses the selection but asks first, with a dialog for the new COMP's name and its parent shortcut.

FNS_QuickPane.name: Active
FNS_QuickPane.label: Active
FNS_QuickPane.help: Turn QuickPane on or off. When on, holding the modifier and dragging from a selected COMP splits the pane in that direction and navigates into it. Off leaves the component installed but idle.

FNS_QuickPane.name: Ratio
FNS_QuickPane.label: Ratio Horz/Vert
FNS_QuickPane.help: How much of the pane the new split takes, 0-1: the first value for a horizontal split, the second for a vertical one.

FNS_QuickPane.name: Keys
FNS_QuickPane.label: Keys
FNS_QuickPane.help: The modifier keys held to trigger this gesture, space-separated (TouchDesigner key names). The default is an expression that picks the right keys per platform. Typing a plain value over it pins the tool to one OS.

FNS_QuickPane.name: Shortcuts
FNS_QuickPane.label: Pane Shortcuts
FNS_QuickPane.help: Hotkeys that split and navigate panes. Separate from Keys, which is the held-modifier set.

FNS_QuickTime.name: Multiplier
FNS_QuickTime.label: Multiplier
FNS_QuickTime.help: Scales the absTime and absFrame references QuickTime hands out: 1 is real time, 0.5 runs them at half speed.

FNS_QuickTime.name: Reset
FNS_QuickTime.label: Reset
FNS_QuickTime.help: Set QuickTime's internal timers back to zero. Middle-clicking the toolbar icon does the same thing.

FNS_RandomCHOP.name: Samples
FNS_RandomCHOP.label: Samples
FNS_RandomCHOP.help: How many values to generate per channel.

FNS_RandomCHOP.name: Channelname
FNS_RandomCHOP.label: Channel Name
FNS_RandomCHOP.help: Name of the output channel.

FNS_RandomCHOP.name: Perchannelpersample
FNS_RandomCHOP.label: Per Channel / Per Sample
FNS_RandomCHOP.help: On: every sample is generated and checked on its own. Off: each channel is generated as one set.

FNS_RandomCHOP.name: Intfloat
FNS_RandomCHOP.label: Int / Float
FNS_RandomCHOP.help: Generate whole numbers or floats.

FNS_RandomCHOP.name: Seed
FNS_RandomCHOP.label: Seed
FNS_RandomCHOP.help: The random seed. The same seed gives the same sequence.

FNS_RandomCHOP.name: Uniformdist
FNS_RandomCHOP.label: Uniform Dist
FNS_RandomCHOP.help: Draw values evenly across the range.

FNS_RandomCHOP.name: Range
FNS_RandomCHOP.label: Range
FNS_RandomCHOP.help: The lowest and highest value generated.

FNS_RandomCHOP.name: Unique
FNS_RandomCHOP.label: Unique
FNS_RandomCHOP.help: Makes sure subsequent generations are different values

FNS_RandomCHOP.name: Tolerance
FNS_RandomCHOP.label: Tolerance
FNS_RandomCHOP.help: How far below and above a recent value a new one must land to count as different. 0 and 0 use a tiny default.

FNS_RandomCHOP.name: Prevncheck
FNS_RandomCHOP.label: Prev N Check
FNS_RandomCHOP.help: How many previous generations a new value is checked against for uniqueness.

FNS_RandomCHOP.name: Normaldist
FNS_RandomCHOP.label: Normal Dist
FNS_RandomCHOP.help: Draw values from a normal distribution shaped by Mean, Spread, Skew and Kurtosis.

FNS_RandomCHOP.name: Userange
FNS_RandomCHOP.label: Use Range
FNS_RandomCHOP.help: Derive the normal distribution from the Range below instead of Mean and Spread: the mean sits at its middle and the spread is a quarter of its width.

FNS_RandomCHOP.name: Normrange
FNS_RandomCHOP.label: Range
FNS_RandomCHOP.help: With Use Range on: the span the normal distribution is built from. Values are not clamped to it.

FNS_RandomCHOP.name: Mean
FNS_RandomCHOP.label: Mean
FNS_RandomCHOP.help: Centre of the normal distribution.

FNS_RandomCHOP.name: Spread
FNS_RandomCHOP.label: Spread
FNS_RandomCHOP.help: Width of the normal distribution.

FNS_RandomCHOP.name: Skew
FNS_RandomCHOP.label: Skew
FNS_RandomCHOP.help: Leans the distribution to one side: negative favours low values, positive high.

FNS_RandomCHOP.name: Kurtosis
FNS_RandomCHOP.label: Kurtosis
FNS_RandomCHOP.help: How peaked the distribution is: positive concentrates values near the mean, negative flattens it.

FNS_RandomCHOP.name: Markovchain
FNS_RandomCHOP.label: Markov Chain
FNS_RandomCHOP.help: Pick each new value from the previous one using a Markov chain.

FNS_RandomCHOP.name: Resetchain
FNS_RandomCHOP.label: Reset Chain
FNS_RandomCHOP.help: Reset the Markov chain to its starting state.

FNS_RandomCHOP.name: Generate
FNS_RandomCHOP.label: Generate
FNS_RandomCHOP.help: Roll new values.

FNS_Remote.name: Active
FNS_Remote.label: Active
FNS_Remote.help: Bind the server and serve this session. Off = nothing listens.

FNS_Remote.name: Port
FNS_Remote.label: Port
FNS_Remote.help: First port of the span to bind (20 ports from here).

FNS_Remote.name: Boundport
FNS_Remote.label: Boundport
FNS_Remote.help: The port actually bound.

FNS_Remote.name: Lan
FNS_Remote.label: Lan
FNS_Remote.help: OFF = loopback only (127.0.0.1). ON = every interface, so phones on your Wi-Fi can reach it. Deliberate act: leave it off unless you want the LAN to see this session.

FNS_Remote.name: Status
FNS_Remote.label: Status
FNS_Remote.help: One line of current state.

FNS_Remote.name: Url
FNS_Remote.label: Url
FNS_Remote.help: Pairing URL (loopback). Carries the access token in the fragment.

FNS_Remote.name: Clienturl
FNS_Remote.label: Client URL
FNS_Remote.help: The client link: the same server with a second token, reaching only the exposed controls. Hand this one to a client or an operator; keep the full link yourself.

FNS_Remote.name: Openpairing
FNS_Remote.label: Open Pairing Page
FNS_Remote.help: Open the pairing page (QR + link) in your browser.

FNS_Remote.name: Regeneratetoken
FNS_Remote.label: Regenerate Token
FNS_Remote.help: Mint a new access token. Every existing link stops working.

FNS_Remote.name: Clientlink
FNS_Remote.label: Pair the Client Link
FNS_Remote.help: On: the pairing window, its QR code and Click to open here hand out the client link, which reaches only the exposed controls. Off: they hand out the full link.

FNS_Remote.name: Clienttouch
FNS_Remote.label: Touch on Client Link
FNS_Remote.help: Whether the client link gets the touch pad as well as the exposed controls. Off hands out a sliders-only page; touch frames from a client are then ignored.

FNS_Remote.name: Maxtouches
FNS_Remote.label: Maxtouches
FNS_Remote.help: How many simultaneous touches to expose as CHOP slots.

FNS_Remote.name: Flipy
FNS_Remote.label: Flipy
FNS_Remote.help: Browser Y counts DOWN from the top; TouchDesigner counts UP from the bottom. On = convert to TD's convention.

FNS_Remote.name: Normalize
FNS_Remote.label: Normalize
FNS_Remote.help: On = 0-1 across the touch area. Off = multiply back up by the phone's reported screen size in pixels.

FNS_Remote.name: Createtarget
FNS_Remote.label: Createtarget
FNS_Remote.help: Where the builder pulses below drop their operators. Blank = the network you have open.

FNS_Remote.name: Createselectchop
FNS_Remote.label: Create Select CHOP
FNS_Remote.help: Build a Select CHOP pointed at the touch channels.

FNS_Remote.name: Createselectdat
FNS_Remote.label: Create Select DAT
FNS_Remote.help: Build a Select DAT pointed at the client table.

FNS_Remote.name: Createreceiver
FNS_Remote.label: Create Receiver
FNS_Remote.help: Build one COMP holding both, ready to drag anywhere.

FNS_Remote.name: Controlstatus
FNS_Remote.label: Controlstatus
FNS_Remote.help: What is currently exposed to the remote.

FNS_Remote.name: Exposeperform
FNS_Remote.label: Expose Perform Window
FNS_Remote.help: Expose the perform window's own custom parameters to the remote.

FNS_Remote.name: Performwindow
FNS_Remote.label: Perform Window
FNS_Remote.help: Blank = the project perform window.

FNS_Remote.name: Performpages
FNS_Remote.label: Perform Page Filter
FNS_Remote.help: Space-separated page names to expose. Blank = all custom pages.

FNS_Remote.name: Performpars
FNS_Remote.label: Perform Parameter Filter
FNS_Remote.help: Space-separated parameter names/patterns. Blank = all.

FNS_Remote.name: Control
FNS_Remote.label: Control
FNS_Remote.help: One block per component the remote page may control: its parameters, filtered by page and name, appear on the phone.

FNS_Remote.name: Control0comp
FNS_Remote.label: Component
FNS_Remote.help: A COMP whose custom parameters the remote may see and drive.

FNS_Remote.name: Control0pages
FNS_Remote.label: Page Filter
FNS_Remote.help: Space-separated page names to expose. Blank = every custom page.

FNS_Remote.name: Control0pars
FNS_Remote.label: Parameter Filter
FNS_Remote.help: Space-separated parameter names or patterns. Blank = all.

FNS_Remote.name: Control0enable
FNS_Remote.label: Active
FNS_Remote.help: Uncheck to hide this block from the remote without clearing it.

FNS_Remote.name: Control1comp
FNS_Remote.label: Component
FNS_Remote.help: A COMP whose custom parameters the remote may see and drive.

FNS_Remote.name: Control1pages
FNS_Remote.label: Page Filter
FNS_Remote.help: Space-separated page names to expose. Blank = every custom page.

FNS_Remote.name: Control1pars
FNS_Remote.label: Parameter Filter
FNS_Remote.help: Space-separated parameter names or patterns. Blank = all.

FNS_Remote.name: Control1enable
FNS_Remote.label: Active
FNS_Remote.help: Uncheck to hide this block from the remote without clearing it.

FNS_ResetPLS.name: Root
FNS_ResetPLS.label: Root
FNS_ResetPLS.help: Where the search for resettable operators starts. Everything under this component is considered, subject to Depth and the exception lists.

FNS_ResetPLS.name: Limitdepth
FNS_ResetPLS.label: Limit Depth
FNS_ResetPLS.help: Stop the search at a fixed number of levels below Root instead of walking the whole tree. Worth it in a big project where a full walk is slow.

FNS_ResetPLS.name: Depth
FNS_ResetPLS.label: Depth
FNS_ResetPLS.help: How many levels below Root to search, when Limit Depth is on.

FNS_ResetPLS.name: Except
FNS_ResetPLS.label: Except
FNS_ResetPLS.help: Operators to leave alone, one pattern per entry. Everything else under Root is reset.

FNS_ResetPLS.name: Exceptionslimit
FNS_ResetPLS.label: Exceptions Limit
FNS_ResetPLS.help: For an excepted COMP, also skip everything inside it. Off resets its children even though the COMP itself is excepted.

FNS_ResetPLS.name: Activeall
FNS_ResetPLS.label: Enable All OPtypes
FNS_ResetPLS.help: Switch on every operator-type toggle across the pages, so the reset covers everything this tool knows how to reset.

FNS_ResetPLS.name: Disableall
FNS_ResetPLS.label: Disable All OPtypes
FNS_ResetPLS.help: Switch off every operator-type toggle, so the reset covers nothing until you pick types back.

FNS_ResetPLS.name: Resetonstartup
FNS_ResetPLS.label: Reset On Startup
FNS_ResetPLS.help: Fire the reset once, automatically, when the project opens.

FNS_ResetPLS.name: Reset
FNS_ResetPLS.label: Reset
FNS_ResetPLS.help: Reset now: pulse the reset parameter of every included operator under Root. This is what the hotkey and the toolbar button do.

FNS_ResetPLS.name: Shortcut
FNS_ResetPLS.label: Reset Shortcut
FNS_ResetPLS.help: Hotkey that pulses Global ResetPLS. Both the Windows and macOS combos are listed.

FNS_ResetPLS.name: Feedbacktop
FNS_ResetPLS.label: Feedback
FNS_ResetPLS.help: Include Feedback TOPs in the reset sweep, so their reset parameter is pulsed along with everything else.

FNS_ResetPLS.name: Cachetop

FNS_ResetPLS.name: Frame
FNS_ResetPLS.label: Reset Frame
FNS_ResetPLS.help: The frame the root timeline jumps to, when Reset Timeline is on.

FNS_ResetPLS.name: Customscript
FNS_ResetPLS.label: Callback

FNS_ResetPLS.name: Createcallbacks
FNS_ResetPLS.label: Create Callbacks
FNS_ResetPLS.help: Create a callbacks DAT beside this component with an onReset stub to fill in, and point the parameter below at it.

FNS_ResetPLS.name: Callbacks
FNS_ResetPLS.label: Callbacks
FNS_ResetPLS.help: The DAT holding the onReset callback. It points at the shipped default until you make your own.

FNS_ResetPLS.name: Open2
FNS_ResetPLS.label: Static Exceptions
FNS_ResetPLS.help: Edit the static exception list: name patterns that are never reset, whatever else is set. Prefix each with '^'. Re-save the component after adding rows, or they are lost with the session.

FNS_ResetPLS.name: Open3
FNS_ResetPLS.label: Edit Custom Reset Pars
FNS_ResetPLS.help: Edit the parameter names this tool treats as a reset on COMPs and Script operators. Defaults are Reset and Resetpulse; add your own component's name here to make it resettable.

FNS_ResetPLS.name: Externalizetables
FNS_ResetPLS.label: Externalize Tables
FNS_ResetPLS.help: Keep this component's tables in files on disk rather than inside the project, so the same exceptions and reset-parameter names follow you between projects.

FNS_ResetPLS.name: Open
FNS_ResetPLS.label: ReadMe

FNS_SearchPalette.name: Autoinstall
FNS_SearchPalette.label: Auto Install at startup
FNS_SearchPalette.help: Put the search field into TouchDesigner's palette browser every time the project opens. This choice roams with your config, so it holds across projects.

FNS_SearchPalette.name: Install
FNS_SearchPalette.label: Install
FNS_SearchPalette.help: Add the search field to the palette browser now, without waiting for the next project start.

FNS_SearchPalette.name: Uninstall
FNS_SearchPalette.label: Uninstall
FNS_SearchPalette.help: Take the search field back out of the palette browser and leave TD's own UI as it was.

FNS_SearchPalette.name: Livesearch
FNS_SearchPalette.label: Live Search
FNS_SearchPalette.help: Rebuild the result list on every keystroke. Off waits until you stop typing, and is worth turning off only if a very large palette makes typing feel heavy.

FNS_SearchPalette.name: Foldersearch
FNS_SearchPalette.label: Folder Search (token/)
FNS_SearchPalette.help: Let a token containing '/' match the FOLDER instead of the component name, so 'gen/ noise' means folder ~gen and name ~noise, and 'tools/' on its own lists a folder.

FNS_SearchPalette.name: Latestonly
FNS_SearchPalette.label: Latest Version Only
FNS_SearchPalette.help: Collapse numbered versions of one component (tool, tool1, tool2, or the same name in two folders) to the most recently modified file.

FNS_SearchPalette.name: Shortcuts
FNS_SearchPalette.label: Search Hotkey
FNS_SearchPalette.help: Keyboard shortcut that opens the Palette Browser and focuses this search field. Rebindable here or in FNS_HotkeyManager; combos join with '.' and several are separated by spaces.

FNS_SearchPalette.name: Autohide
FNS_SearchPalette.label: Hide Palette When Idle
FNS_SearchPalette.help: Close the palette browser after it has gone unused for the number of minutes below. Unused means the mouse is outside the palette and nothing is being typed into the search field. Off by default; the palette stays open until you close it.

FNS_SearchPalette.name: Autohideminutes
FNS_SearchPalette.label: Hide After (Minutes)
FNS_SearchPalette.help: Minutes without interaction before the palette browser closes, when Hide Palette When Idle is on. The countdown restarts whenever the mouse enters the palette or the search field is typed into.

FNS_SearchPalette.name: Githubpage
FNS_SearchPalette.label: Github Page
FNS_SearchPalette.help: Open the upstream project's GitHub page (Yea Chen's TD-SearchPalette) in your browser.

FNS_SearchPalette.name: Releasenotes
FNS_SearchPalette.label: Release Notes
FNS_SearchPalette.help: Open the upstream project's release notes in your browser.

FNS_SearchPalette.name: Version
FNS_SearchPalette.label: Version
FNS_SearchPalette.help: The vendored component's own version, as its author numbers it. Not the package version the updater compares.

FNS_SearchPalette.name: Tdbuild
FNS_SearchPalette.label: TD Build
FNS_SearchPalette.help: The TouchDesigner build this component was authored against.

FNS_SearchPalette.name: Author
FNS_SearchPalette.label: Author
FNS_SearchPalette.help: Who wrote the component this package vendors.

FNS_SetSmoothness.name: Inputfiltertype
FNS_SetSmoothness.label: Input Smoothness
FNS_SetSmoothness.help: The Input Smoothness value written to the TOPs you apply to: how the texture is sampled coming in. 'Use Input' leaves each TOP's existing setting alone.

FNS_SetSmoothness.name: Filtertype
FNS_SetSmoothness.label: Viewer Smoothness
FNS_SetSmoothness.help: The Viewer Smoothness value written to the TOPs you apply to: how the texture is filtered when displayed. 'Use Input' leaves each TOP's existing setting alone.

FNS_SetSmoothness.name: Selected
FNS_SetSmoothness.label: Selected
FNS_SetSmoothness.help: Apply the two smoothness settings above to the currently selected TOPs.

FNS_SetSmoothness.name: All
FNS_SetSmoothness.label: All
FNS_SetSmoothness.help: Apply the two smoothness settings above to every TOP in the current network.

FNS_SetSmoothness.name: Keys
FNS_SetSmoothness.label: Modifier Key
FNS_SetSmoothness.help: Modifier held while scrolling to set input smoothness on the hovered operator.

FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.name: Active
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.label: Active
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.help: Master switch. Off: no transitions happen, every scene COMP is allowed to cook and node colours are restored. On: reconciles to the current Select.

FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.name: Select
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.label: Select
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.help: Index of the scene to show, counting from 0; Loop Type decides what happens outside 0..Num Scenes-1. Drive it with a constant, an expression, a bind or a CHOP export. A change during a running transition restarts it toward the new scene; choosing the visible scene cancels it.

FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.name: Selectmenu
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.label: Select Menu
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.help: Pick the scene by name. Mirrors Select when Select is a constant or bind.

FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.name: Looptype
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.label: Loop Type
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.help: How Select values outside 0..Num Scenes-1 are handled: Clamp holds at the ends, Loop wraps around (modulo), Zigzag bounces back and forth.

FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.name: Currentselect
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.label: Current Select
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.help: Read-only: the scene currently visible (updated when a transition completes).

FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.name: Numscenes
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.label: Num Scenes
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.help: Read-only: the number of scenes, one per Inputs block (a wired connector or a TOP / COMP reference).

FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.name: Progress
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.label: Progress
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.help: Read-only: 0-1 progress of the running transition (across both halves in Fade Through Black).

FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.name: Finishtransition
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.label: Finish Transition
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.help: Complete the switch under way right now: a running crossfade or fade lands on its target, a Pre-Roll cuts straight to the scene it was warming, and a half-moved A/B Fader completes. Does nothing when idle. Python: FinishTransition().

FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.name: Switchmode
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.label: Switch Mode
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.help: How a scene change is performed. Crossfade blends over Crossfade Length; Fade Through Black fades the old scene out (Fade Out Time) then the new in (Fade In Time); Cut switches instantly; the two A/B Fader modes are driven by the Fader parameter like a DJ crossfader: the end the Fader rests at shows the current scene, moving it to the other end switches to the Select scene, and that end becomes the new resting end.

FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.name: Length
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.label: Crossfade Length
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.help: Duration in seconds of a crossfade (Switch Mode = Crossfade). A scene COMP with a 'Fadeintime' custom parameter overrides it for that scene.

FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.name: Easing
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.label: Easing
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.help: Easing curve for timed transitions: the crossfade, and both halves of Fade Through Black. Not used by the A/B Fader modes. A scene COMP can override it with Fadeincurve / Fadeoutcurve custom parameters.

FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.name: Fadeouttime
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.label: Fade Out Time
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.help: Seconds to fade the outgoing scene to black in Fade Through Black mode. A scene COMP with its own 'Fadeouttime' custom parameter overrides this.

FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.name: Fadeintime
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.label: Fade In Time
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.help: Seconds to fade the incoming scene up from black in Fade Through Black mode. A scene COMP with its own 'Fadeintime' custom parameter overrides this (in Crossfade mode it overrides Crossfade Length).

FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.name: Fadestyle
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.label: Fade Style
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.help: What 'black' means in Fade Through Black mode: To Black drives RGB to black and keeps alpha (opaque black); To Transparent fades opacity so the output becomes transparent.

FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.name: Fader
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.label: A/B Fader
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.help: Manual transition control in the A/B Fader modes. Whichever end (0 or 1) the Fader rests at is the current scene. Set Select to the next scene, then move the Fader to the opposite end: the blend (or the fade through black) follows the Fader and the switch completes on arrival, so the opposite end becomes the new resting end. Turning back before arriving cancels; changing Select mid-way re-targets. Drive it from a physical fader or a CHOP.

FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.name: Auto
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.label: Auto Advance
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.help: Switch to the next scene every Interval. Off pauses the countdown where it is; choosing a scene by hand (Select, Select Menu, Switch()) restarts it from that scene.

FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.name: Autoadvanceon
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.label: Advance On
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.help: Timer: switch every Interval. A/B Fader: each time the A/B Fader completes a switch, Select moves to the next scene (in Order and Direction), so the next push of the Fader goes there. Only in the two A/B Fader modes.

FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.name: Autointerval
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.label: Interval
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.help: Seconds between switches, the transition included: every Interval the next scene starts to arrive.

FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.name: Autoorder
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.label: Order
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.help: Sequential steps through the scenes in Direction; Loop Type decides the ends (Clamp stops, Loop wraps, Zigzag turns round). Random shows every other scene once, in a shuffled order, before any repeats.

FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.name: Autodirection
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.label: Direction
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.help: Sequential order: step to the next (Forward) or previous (Back) scene index.

FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.name: Autoseed
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.label: Random Seed
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.help: Random order: the same seed always gives the same sequence of shuffles.

FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.name: Autonext
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.label: Next Switch In
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.help: Read-only: seconds until Auto Advance switches.

FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.name: Res
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.label: Res
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.help: Output resolution of the changer: width and height in pixels.

FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.name: Inputs
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.label: Inputs
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.help: The scenes, one block each. Add blocks for more scenes; each block is one scene index, counting from 0.

FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.name: Inputs0top
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.label: TOP
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.help: Scene source: a TOP is shown as it is; a COMP shows its Out TOP, otherwise a display-flagged TOP inside it, otherwise its right-most TOP. A reference takes precedence over a wire on the same input connector.

FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.name: Inputs1top
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.label: TOP
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.help: Scene source: a TOP is shown as it is; a COMP shows its Out TOP, otherwise a display-flagged TOP inside it, otherwise its right-most TOP. A reference takes precedence over a wire on the same input connector.

FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.name: Inputs2top
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.label: TOP
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.help: Scene source: a TOP is shown as it is; a COMP shows its Out TOP, otherwise a display-flagged TOP inside it, otherwise its right-most TOP. A reference takes precedence over a wire on the same input connector.

FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.name: Controlcook
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.label: Control Cook
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.help: When on, only the scenes that need to cook are allowed to: the visible one, the incoming one during a transition, one warming up for its Pre-Roll and ones still in their Outro. Every other scene COMP has cooking disabled. Bare TOP scenes are never touched.

FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.name: Preroll
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.label: Pre-Roll (start cooking before switch)
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.help: Seconds the target scene cooks before its transition starts. When Select changes, the target COMP is allowed to cook immediately and the switch itself is delayed by this much, so feedback loops, movies or particle systems are warm when they appear. Changing Select again during the pre-roll re-targets it; choosing the visible scene cancels it. In the A/B Fader modes any value above 0 simply warms the chosen scene as soon as Select changes.

FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.name: Outro
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.label: Outro (keep cooking after switch)
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.help: Seconds the outgoing scene keeps cooking after the switch has completed, so an exit animation can finish off-screen. When the time is up the scene is uncooked and unloaded as usual (unless it has become visible again).

FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.name: Unload
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.label: Unload
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.help: When a scene stops cooking, release its CPU/GPU memory (TOPs, CHOPs, SOPs, movie caches) and free POP GPU memory, paced by Unload Budget.

FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.name: Unloadmethod
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.label: Unload Method
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.help: How an uncooked scene's memory is released. Progressive uses COMP.progressiveUnload() paced by Unload Budget and covers every node type including POPs. Immediate calls unload() on each unlocked TOP in a single frame.

FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.name: Unloadbudget
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.label: Unload Budget (ms/frame)
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.help: Milliseconds per frame spent releasing an uncooked scene's CPU/GPU memory (COMP.progressiveUnload). Spreads the unload over several frames so a heavy scene never hitches the frame it stops cooking. 0 unloads everything in a single frame.

FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.name: Reverseinputs
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.label: Reverse Inputs
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.help: Reconnect the wired inputs in reverse order. Applies to inputs wired into the connectors, not to the Inputs sequence TOP references.

FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.name: Randomizeinputs
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.label: Randomize Inputs
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.help: Reconnect the wired inputs in a random order.

FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.name: Nodeytoorder
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.label: NodeY to Order (reconnect)
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.help: Reconnect the wired inputs so the input order matches their top-to-bottom position in the network editor.

FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.name: Ordertonodey
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.label: Order to NodeY (swap)
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.help: Swap the wired inputs' node positions so top-to-bottom matches the input order (input 0 on top).

FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.name: Positiontoorder
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.label: ^ automatic
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.help: Keep NodeY to Order applied automatically: whenever a wired input COMP is moved in the network editor, the inputs are reconnected to match.

FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.name: Aligninputs
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.label: Align Inputs (retoggle)
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.help: While on, the wired input COMPs are kept stacked in one column beside the changer (input 0 on top) using Alignment Mode and Adjust Offset; changing either re-aligns immediately, and so does a wiring change. Turn it off and on again to re-align after moving things by hand.

FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.name: Alignmentmode
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.label: Alignment Mode
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.help: Where the column sits relative to the changer: Top aligns the first input with the changer's top edge, Center centres the column, Bottom aligns the last input with the changer's bottom edge.

FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.name: Adjust
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.label: Adjust Offset (X, Y, YGap)
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.help: Align Inputs offsets in network units: X offset of the column from the changer, Y offset, and the vertical gap between inputs.

FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.name: Colorize
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.label: Colorize Scenes
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.help: Tint the scene COMPs in the network editor: the visible (and incoming) scene gets On Color, the others Off Color. Original colours are restored when turned off.

FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.name: Oncolor
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.label: On Color
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.help: Node colour of the visible scene COMP while Colorize is on.

FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.name: Offcolor
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.label: Off Color
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.help: Node colour of the idle scene COMPs while Colorize is on.

FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.name: Keeporiginal
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.label: Off = Keep Original Color
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.help: When on, idle scenes get their own original node colour back instead of Off Color. The original colour of each scene COMP is remembered the first time it is tinted, so it can always be restored.

FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.name: Callbacks
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.label: Callbacks
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.help: The DAT holding your callback functions (onPrerollStart, onTransitionStart, onSelectionChange, ...). It points at the built-in template, which does nothing, until you use Create Callbacks.

FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.name: Createcallbacks
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.label: Create Callbacks
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.help: Create an editable callbacks DAT next to the changer, with every callback documented inside, and point Callbacks at it.

FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.name: Opendocs
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.label: Open Documentation
FNS_SimpleSceneChanger.help: Open the built-in documentation (the 'help' Text DAT inside the component) in a viewer window.

FNS_SwapOps.name: Active
FNS_SwapOps.label: Active
FNS_SwapOps.help: Turn SwapOps on or off. When on, the shortcut and the toolbar button swap the selected operators in place. Off leaves the component installed but idle.

FNS_SwapOps.name: Swap
FNS_SwapOps.label: Swap
FNS_SwapOps.help: Swap the operators selected right now, the same action as the shortcut and the toolbar button.

FNS_SwapOps.name: Shortcuts
FNS_SwapOps.label: Shortcuts
FNS_SwapOps.help: Key that swaps the selected operators. Two swap with each other; a longer selection is mirrored end to end.

FNS_SwitchOPs.name: Active
FNS_SwitchOPs.label: Active
FNS_SwitchOPs.help: Turn SwitchOPs on or off. When on, the switch shortcut jumps focus back and forth between the two most recently selected operators. Off leaves the component installed but idle.

FNS_SwitchOPs.name: Shortcut
FNS_SwitchOPs.label: Shortcut
FNS_SwitchOPs.help: Hotkey that switches between recently visited operators.

FNS_SwitchTools.name: Switchop
FNS_SwitchTools.label: Switch OP
FNS_SwitchTools.help: The Switch, Cross or multi-input operator to drive. Dropping the tool next to it or docking it sets this too.

FNS_SwitchTools.name: Bind
FNS_SwitchTools.label: Bind
FNS_SwitchTools.help: Bind the switch operator's index (or Cross) to this tool's Index, so either one moves the other.

FNS_SwitchTools.name: Index
FNS_SwitchTools.label: Index
FNS_SwitchTools.help: Which input is shown. With Blend on, values between inputs crossfade.

FNS_SwitchTools.name: Blend
FNS_SwitchTools.label: Blend
FNS_SwitchTools.help: Turn on the switch operator's blending between inputs, so fractional indexes crossfade.

FNS_SwitchTools.name: Type
FNS_SwitchTools.label: Loop Type
FNS_SwitchTools.help: What happens when Index runs past the first or last input: off, clamp at the ends, loop round, or zigzag back.

FNS_SwitchTools.name: Select
FNS_SwitchTools.label: Select
FNS_SwitchTools.help: Pick an input by name; sets Index.

FNS_SwitchTools.name: Currentselect
FNS_SwitchTools.label: Current Select
FNS_SwitchTools.help: Read-only: the input currently shown.

FNS_SwitchTools.name: Outindex
FNS_SwitchTools.label: Out Index
FNS_SwitchTools.help: Read-only: the index actually sent to the switch operator after Loop Type.

FNS_SwitchTools.name: Numinputs
FNS_SwitchTools.label: Num Inputs
FNS_SwitchTools.help: Read-only: how many inputs the switch operator has.

FNS_SwitchTools.name: Controlcook
FNS_SwitchTools.label: Control Cook (COMPs)
FNS_SwitchTools.help: Let only the input COMPs in use cook; the rest stop cooking until selected.

FNS_SwitchTools.name: Unloadgpu
FNS_SwitchTools.label: Unload GPU
FNS_SwitchTools.help: When an input stops being used, release its COMP's CPU/GPU memory a few frames later (cancelled if it is selected again first), paced by Unload Method and Unload Budget.

FNS_SwitchTools.name: Unloadmethod
FNS_SwitchTools.label: Unload Method
FNS_SwitchTools.help: How an unused input COMP's memory is released. Progressive uses COMP.progressiveUnload() paced by Unload Budget and covers every node type including POPs. Immediate calls unload() on each unlocked TOP in one frame (the previous behaviour).

FNS_SwitchTools.name: Unloadbudget
FNS_SwitchTools.label: Unload Budget (ms/frame)
FNS_SwitchTools.help: Milliseconds per frame spent releasing an unused input's memory (COMP.progressiveUnload). Spreads the unload over several frames so a heavy input never hitches the frame it stops being used. 0 unloads everything in a single frame.

FNS_SwitchTools.name: Colorize
FNS_SwitchTools.label: Colorize
FNS_SwitchTools.help: Colour input nodes by state: On Color for the one in use, Off Color for the rest.

FNS_SwitchTools.name: Oncolor
FNS_SwitchTools.label: On Color
FNS_SwitchTools.help: Node colour of the input in use, with Colorize on.

FNS_SwitchTools.name: Offcolor
FNS_SwitchTools.label: Off Color
FNS_SwitchTools.help: Node colour of the inputs not in use, with Colorize on.

FNS_SwitchTools.name: Active
FNS_SwitchTools.label: Active
FNS_SwitchTools.help: Turn the tool off without removing it: the switch operator is unbound and left as it is.

FNS_SwitchTools.name: Reverseinputs
FNS_SwitchTools.label: Reverse Inputs
FNS_SwitchTools.help: Reverse the order the inputs are wired in.

FNS_SwitchTools.name: Randomize
FNS_SwitchTools.label: Randomize Inputs
FNS_SwitchTools.help: Rewire the inputs in a random order.

FNS_SwitchTools.name: Reorderswitchops
FNS_SwitchTools.label: Order to NodeY (swap)
FNS_SwitchTools.help: Move the input nodes so their vertical position follows their input order.

FNS_SwitchTools.name: Reorderswitchinputs
FNS_SwitchTools.label: NodeY to Order (reconnect)
FNS_SwitchTools.help: Rewire the inputs so their order follows the nodes' vertical position.

FNS_SwitchTools.name: Positiontoorder
FNS_SwitchTools.label: ^(automatic)^
FNS_SwitchTools.help: Rewire automatically whenever an input node is moved, so the order always follows the layout.

FNS_SwitchTools.name: Redigitizeinputs
FNS_SwitchTools.label: Re-Digitize Inputs (rename)
FNS_SwitchTools.help: Change the digits of the inputs to match the select index

FNS_SwitchTools.name: Onebasedindex
FNS_SwitchTools.label: ^1 based index^
FNS_SwitchTools.help: Number inputs from 1 instead of 0 when renaming them.

FNS_SwitchTools.name: Aligninputs
FNS_SwitchTools.label: Align Inputs (retoggle)
FNS_SwitchTools.help: Re-toggle to re-align

FNS_SwitchTools.name: Alignmentmode
FNS_SwitchTools.label: Alignment Mode
FNS_SwitchTools.help: How Align Inputs lines the input nodes up: top, centre or bottom.

FNS_SwitchTools.name: Adjust
FNS_SwitchTools.label: Adjust Offset (X, Y, YGap)
FNS_SwitchTools.help: Offsets used when aligning inputs: horizontal offset, vertical offset and the gap between nodes.

FNS_SwitchTools.name: Save
FNS_SwitchTools.label: Save as Original
FNS_SwitchTools.help: Remember the current input wiring as the original.

FNS_SwitchTools.name: Restore
FNS_SwitchTools.label: Restore Original
FNS_SwitchTools.help: Rewire the inputs back to the saved original.

FNS_SwitchTools.name: Disconnectall
FNS_SwitchTools.label: Disconnect All Inputs
FNS_SwitchTools.help: Disconnect every input of the switch operator.

FNS_SwitchTools.name: Firstlast
FNS_SwitchTools.label: First == Last
FNS_SwitchTools.help: The last input repeats the first, so a loop closes cleanly; it is left out of reordering.

FNS_SwitchTools.name: Callbacks
FNS_SwitchTools.label: Callbacks
FNS_SwitchTools.help: The DAT holding your callbacks: onCookingChange and onSelectionChange.

FNS_SwitchTools.name: Createcallbacks
FNS_SwitchTools.label: Create Callbacks
FNS_SwitchTools.help: Create a callbacks DAT beside the tool and point Callbacks at it.

FNS_SwitchTools.name: Builtinpages
FNS_SwitchTools.label: Show Builtin Pages
FNS_SwitchTools.help: Show the component's built-in parameter pages.

FNS_TimelineRegistry.name: Comp
FNS_TimelineRegistry.label: Widget COMP
FNS_TimelineRegistry.help: Panel COMP published as the toolbar widget. Defaults to the parent component.

FNS_TimelineRegistry.name: Canonicalname
FNS_TimelineRegistry.label: Canonical Name
FNS_TimelineRegistry.help: Unique name for this widget in the global toolbar registry.

FNS_TimelineRegistry.name: Callback
FNS_TimelineRegistry.label: Callback DAT
FNS_TimelineRegistry.help: Optional DAT with toolbar callbacks for this widget.

FNS_TimelineRegistry.name: Autoregister
FNS_TimelineRegistry.label: Auto-register
FNS_TimelineRegistry.help: When on, keep this widget published into the global toolbar registry while this component exists.

FNS_TimelineRegistry.name: Register
FNS_TimelineRegistry.label: Register
FNS_TimelineRegistry.help: Publish once into the global toolbar registry, even if Auto-register is off.

FNS_TimelineRegistry.name: Unregister
FNS_TimelineRegistry.label: Unregister
FNS_TimelineRegistry.help: Take this tool's contribution back out of the registry and turn Autoregister off, so it stays out. Register puts it back.

FNS_TimelineRegistry.name: Regstatus
FNS_TimelineRegistry.label: Registration Status
FNS_TimelineRegistry.help: Read-only status of this host registration.

FNS_TimelineRegistry.name: Menuorder
FNS_TimelineRegistry.label: Toolbar Order
FNS_TimelineRegistry.help: Preferred order among registered widgets, managed by the global registry. -1 = no preference (append at the end).

FNS_TimelineRegistry.name: Displayed
FNS_TimelineRegistry.label: Displayed
FNS_TimelineRegistry.help: Default visibility of the widget in the toolbar (managed by the global registry).

FNS_TimelineRegistry.name: Barwidth
FNS_TimelineRegistry.label: Bar Width
FNS_TimelineRegistry.help: Width of this widget in the toolbar. 0 = auto (follow the widget). Persisted here; the registry writes manager edits back.

FNS_TimelineRegistry.name: Barheight
FNS_TimelineRegistry.label: Bar Height
FNS_TimelineRegistry.help: Height of this widget in its zone. 0 = the zone's own row height. The registry sizes the SOURCE panel to this, because a mirror is a window onto the widget and not a scaler, so an oversized source shows only its top-left corner in the slot.

FNS_TimelineRegistry.name: Zone
FNS_TimelineRegistry.label: Timeline Zone
FNS_TimelineRegistry.help: Which part of TD's timeline this widget is published into. 'Transport row' appends it after the native play/stop controls.
